Il fatto che si desidera spostare la Svizzera con noi è la più grande motivazione per noi. Pertanto, ci asteniamo da una lettera di motivazione a questo punto. Se volete ancora dirci la vostra motivazione, avete ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di applicazione.
Fare il grande è più facile per te. Questo inizia con la tua applicazione.

Move Switzerland with us.
Electrician, automation engineer for entry into the railway safety systems sector
Sargans, immediately or by appointment, 60-100%
Apply now

## You can look forward to this. You are an electrician or automation engineer with heart and soul and would like to take on responsibility in the area of ​​security systems. In an innovative environment, you and your team will drive forward the digital development of the infrastructure and thus make a visible contribution to the safety and punctuality of trains. Together you will develop practical solutions for current challenges and implement them as a team. We support your professional development with internal training and further education, including two-year training to become a security system technician. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - You oversee the construction, maintenance and repair of safety systems and thus ensure safe and punctual rail traffic. - You ensure the decommissioning and commissioning of electronic signal boxes and relay signal boxes. - With your systematic approach, you identify irregularities and deficiencies, report them and promote resolution and improvements within the team. - In the Sargans area you will work at various indoor and outdoor locations and experience a varied working day.

- You complete an internal two-year training course to become a security system technician and learn to independently locate and resolve faults in indoor systems. - In the on-call service, you independently locate and repair faults in security systems. This is what you bring with you. - You enjoy working in a team, taking responsibility and communicating clearly and in a solution-oriented manner. - Safety is your priority and you approach tasks systematically to solve problems in a structured manner. - You have completed basic training with EFZ in an electrical engineering profession such as automation, electromechanics or electrical assembly or a comparable qualification. - You have the necessary stamina to work in shifts. You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - So that you can perform on-call duty, you have a category B driving license. You have German language skills at level B2, both spoken and written.

## Your salary and your benefits.
We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level E, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits.

## This gets you started.
The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool.
Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application.

Final decision 4 - 6 weeks after receipt of application

## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. Vous êtes électricien ou automation avec cœur et âme et souhaitez assumer des responsabilités dans le domaine des systèmes de sécurité. Dans un environnement innovant, vous et votre équipe piloterez le développement numérique de l’infrastructure et apporterez ainsi une contribution visible à la sécurité et à la ponctualité des trains. Ensemble, vous développerez des solutions pratiques aux défis actuels et les mettrez en œuvre en équipe. Nous soutenons votre évolution professionnelle par des formations internes et continues, notamment une formation de deux ans pour devenir technicien en systèmes de sécurité. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels que l'AG gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - Vous supervisez la construction, l'entretien et la réparation des systèmes de sécurité et assurez ainsi un trafic ferroviaire sûr et ponctuel. - Vous assurez le démantèlement et la mise en service des coffrets de signalisation électronique et des coffrets de signalisation relais. - Grâce à votre approche systématique, vous identifiez les irrégularités et les déficiences, les signalez et favorisez la résolution et les améliorations au sein de l'équipe. - Dans la région de Sargans, vous travaillerez sur différents lieux intérieurs et extérieurs et vivrez une journée de travail variée.

- Vous suivez une formation interne de deux ans pour devenir technicien en systèmes de sécurité et apprenez à localiser et résoudre de manière autonome les défauts des systèmes intérieurs. - Au service d'astreinte, vous localisez et réparez en toute autonomie les pannes des systèmes de sécurité. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous aimez travailler en équipe, assumer des responsabilités et communiquer de manière claire et orientée solutions. - La sécurité est votre priorité et vous abordez les tâches systématiquement pour résoudre les problèmes de manière structurée. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base auprès de l'EFZ dans un métier de l'électrotechnique tel que l'automatisation, l'électromécanique ou le montage électrique ou une qualification comparable. - Vous avez l'endurance nécessaire pour travailler en équipe. Vous êtes attentif, concentré et résilient physiquement afin de mener à bien ce travail exigeant en 24 heures. Vous aimez également travailler dehors par tous les temps. - Pour pouvoir effectuer des astreintes, vous disposez d'un permis de conduire de catégorie B. Vous possédez des compétences en allemand de niveau B2, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.

## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux.
Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence E, niveau d'allocation régionale 0. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux.

Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature.
Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature.

Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche leere Schwimmbäder geniessen und deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten. - Du erledigst Schaltarbeiten und erteilst Schaltaufträge. Ebenso verrichtest du selbständig die erforderlichen Erdungsarbeiten.
- Durch dein Fachwissen und das damit verbundene Können führst du Bauzüge, bedienst Arbeitskörbe und Krane und verfügst über die entsprechende Ausbildung hierfür.
- Dass du bereit bist, zu unregelmässigen Zeiten, insbesondere nachts und teilweise am Wochenende, zu arbeiten, setzen wir voraus.
Das bringst du mit.

## You can look forward to this. As a catenary line technician, you build and maintain the traction power supply and ensure voltage in the trains. Exciting tasks await you in a great and motivated team, changing locations and a technical job with real responsibility. We are looking for support in these locations in German-speaking Switzerland: Zurich, Brugg, Dulliken, Ostermundigen, Gossau (SG), Rapperswil and Winterthur. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. But you can enjoy empty swimming pools during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. You also benefit from attractive time bonuses. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can get further insights into the job as a transport route builder / track builder at the SBB's professional world or directly here: Network electrician in catenary | SBB
You can move that. - As a contact line technician, you and your team carry out all maintenance, renewal work and troubleshooting on contact line systems. - You carry out switching work and issue switching orders. You also carry out the necessary grounding work independently. - Thanks to your specialist knowledge and the associated skills, you will lead construction trains, operate work baskets and cranes and have the appropriate training for this.

- We assume that you are willing to work at irregular hours, especially at night and sometimes on weekends. This is what you bring with you. - You are a team player, skilled in craftsmanship, with a strong awareness of safety and always enjoy continuing your education. - Ideally, experience would be in catenary, overhead line or metal construction. - We require proof of skills from the electrical industry, metal construction or construction industry and an impeccable reputation. - You have the willingness to be trained as a security chief or security manager according to RT20100 and as a train driver. - To succeed in this role, you must communicate fluently in German.

We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 2. More about wages and benefits.

The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool.

Postulez maintenant

## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. En tant que technicien de ligne caténaire, vous construisez et entretenez l'alimentation électrique de traction et assurez la tension dans les trains. Des tâches passionnantes vous attendent au sein d'une équipe formidable et motivée, des changements de lieux et un travail technique avec de vraies responsabilités. Nous recherchons du soutien dans ces localités de Suisse alémanique : Zurich, Brugg, Dulliken, Ostermundigen, Gossau (SG), Rapperswil et Winterthur. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Mais vous pouvez profiter de piscines vides en semaine et organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Vous bénéficiez également de primes de temps attractives. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous trouverez de plus amples informations sur le métier de constructeur d'itinéraires de transport / constructeur de voies dans l'univers professionnel des CFF ou directement ici : Électricien de réseau en caténaire | CFF
Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que technicien de ligne de contact, vous et votre équipe effectuez tous les travaux de maintenance, de renouvellement et de dépannage des systèmes de ligne de contact. - Vous effectuez les travaux d'aiguillage et émettez les ordres d'aiguillage. Vous effectuez également les travaux de mise à la terre nécessaires en toute autonomie. - Grâce à vos connaissances spécialisées et aux compétences associées, vous dirigerez des trains de chantier, actionnerez des nacelles de travail et des grues et disposerez de la formation appropriée à cet effet.

- Nous supposons que vous êtes prêt à travailler à des horaires irréguliers, notamment la nuit et parfois le week-end. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe, un savoir-faire artisanal, une forte conscience de la sécurité et aimez toujours poursuivre vos études. - Idéalement, l'expérience serait dans le domaine des caténaires, des lignes aériennes ou de la construction métallique. - Nous exigeons une preuve de compétences de l'industrie électrique, de la construction métallique ou du bâtiment et une réputation irréprochable. - Vous avez la volonté d'être formé comme chef de sécurité ou responsable de sécurité selon la RT20100 et comme conducteur de train. - Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous devez communiquer couramment en allemand.

## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux.
Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence D, niveau d'allocation régionale 2. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux.

## Cela vous permet de démarrer.
Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature.
Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. Cela commence par votre candidature.

## Non vedo l'ora.
In qualità di tecnico, siete responsabili della costruzione, manutenzione e manutenzione dei vari sistemi di sicurezza come interruttori, sistemi di passaggio a livello, segnali o sistemi di traccia. Inoltre, sarà diagnosticare i guasti e svolgere in modo indipendente impegnativo lavoro meccanico ruvido nella zona esterna dei sistemi di sicurezza.
Siamo alla ricerca di supporto in queste località della Svizzera tedesca: Sargans, Olten e Lucerna.
Le condizioni di lavoro interessanti sono importanti per noi, anche per le ore di lavoro irregolari. Durante la settimana potrete usufruire di piscine vuote e rendere il vostro tempo libero più flessibile. Il lavoro notturno e fine settimana viene pagato anche con noi - ad esempio con 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Si beneficiano anche di supplementi di tempo. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero di dipendenti senza incarichi di notte e fine settimana. I nostri altri vantaggi come assegni per bambini, libero 2 ° classe GA e viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - possono essere trovati sul nostro sito web sotto " Vantaggi".
Ulteriori informazioni sulla professione come tecnico del sistema di sicurezza: è possibile uscire al mondo professionale delle FFS o direttamente qui: Tecnico: nei sistemi di sicurezza al di fuori delle FFS
Puoi spostarlo.
- Effettuate in modo indipendente il lavoro nel montaggio / smontaggio di impianti secondo il progetto. Le attività di manutenzione sui sistemi esterni SA in funzione (interruttori, segnali, sistemi di rilevamento binari, controllo treno, ETCS, riscaldamento a punto) fanno parte anche della vostra area di responsabilità.
- Disruzione delle installazioni ferroviarie all'interno del telaio dell'organizzazione pikett si effettua indipendentemente.
- Si segnala il lavoro svolto con i più recenti sistemi e programmi e lavorare sul monitoraggio dei documenti.
Lo porti con te.
- Prontezza per piquetting, lavoro notturno e lavoro di fine settimana, nonché la formazione di sicurezza come capo della sicurezza: in RTE 20100.
- Hai un apprendistato professionale completato EFZ come meccanico di produzione:in, fabbro:in, polimeccanico:in o in una direzione simile dell'artigianato.
- Prontezza per completare la formazione interna part-time di un anno per i tecnici: nei sistemi di sicurezza esterni. SBB assume tempo pieno e costi per questo.
- È richiesta una patente di guida valida della categoria B e una buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura di almeno il livello B2.

## La tua ricompensa e i tuoi benefici.
Abbiamo un sistema salariale equo e progressivo e siamo attivamente impegnati a parità di retribuzione. Per questo motivo, ulteriori e dettagliate informazioni sul sistema salariale possono essere visualizzate in modo trasparente presso le FFS. Questo lavoro è in Requirement Livello D, Regional Allowance Livello 2.

## Questo è il punto di partenza.
Il fatto che si desidera spostare la Svizzera con noi è la più grande motivazione per noi. Pertanto, ci asteniamo da una lettera di motivazione a questo punto. Se volete ancora dirci la vostra motivazione, avete ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di applicazione.
Fare il grande è più facile per te. Questo inizia con la tua applicazione.

Come autista del treno, fai un grande affare: alla SBB Passenger Transport, ti muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di viaggiatori. Dopo aver completato il secondo allenamento di 15 mesi pagato, il lavoro ti porta lungo le più belle linee ferroviarie in Svizzera. Porti i nostri passeggeri a destinazione in tempo e garantisci così un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS.
Pieno di prospettive è anche il vostro lavoro quotidiano con condizioni quadro attraenti per tutte le situazioni di vita. Il lavoro notturno e fine settimana viene pagato anche per – ad esempio, con 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per le assegnazioni notturne, hai anche supplementi di tempo tra il 10 e il 30 per cento. Questo significa che hai più tempo libero dei dipendenti senza incarichi di notte e weekend. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également d'un supplément de temps compris entre 10 et 30 pour cent. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. De plus, après une formation de conducteur de train, vous pouvez définir individuellement votre charge de travail à partir de 60 pour cent sur consultation, avec différents modèles à temps partiel qui s'offrent à vous. - Vous abordez les défis avec calme, prenez des décisions réfléchies même dans des situations stressantes et êtes prêt à travailler par quarts. - Vous parlez couramment l'allemand (niveau C2) et avez des connaissances de français débutant (niveau A1). - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites. - Vous avez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de motivation pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante et êtes prêt à vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en classe sur site à l'auto-apprentissage numérique.

descriptionByLocale.en: Train driver shunting Basel 2027 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Train driver shunting Basel 2027 Basel, January 1st, 2027 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. Around 14,000 passenger transport employees ensure that the more than 1.3 million SBB customers we transport every day have easy access to public transport and travel from A to B both safely and on time. As a central professional group, the shunting personnel make a key contribution to this. An innovative working environment awaits you, in which you will move SBB together with your teammates, as well as varied and paid training. You also have various internal training opportunities. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will receive additional time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start dates: - January 1st, 2027 - May 1st, 2027 - June 1st, 2027 - August 1st, 2027 - October 1st, 2027 You can move this. - You prepare passenger trains for their journey, carry out shunting movements on train compositions and drive various locomotives at a maximum speed of 30 km/h within a limited radius of the train station to the defined starting point. - During maneuvering movements, you monitor the road and ensure safety. - You create the readiness to drive, enter data from the safety and information systems and carry out brake tests. - If possible, you can repair minor defects or malfunctions in the vehicle yourself or report them to the responsible authority using the appropriate tools. - Operations as a shunting specialist (Ai40) in full tours are a matter of course for you. You couple and uncouple rail vehicles, direct individual shunting movements and reset train compositions. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work in 24-hour shift work, you are physically and mentally resilient and enjoy working outside in any weather. - In your daily work you use, among other things, a tablet. You don't have to worry about using modern work equipment. - You have completed basic education (at least EBA) and ideally have completed a vocational apprenticeship. You also have professional experience in crafts, logistics or comparable areas. - You have very good spoken and written knowledge of German. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) ## Your salary and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier with you. Conducteur de train manœuvres Bâle 2027 Bâle, le 1er janvier 2027 ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Près de 14 000 collaborateurs du secteur du transport de voyageurs veillent à ce que plus de 1,3 million de clients CFF que nous transportons chaque jour puissent accéder facilement aux transports publics et se rendre d'un point A à un point B en toute sécurité et à temps. En tant que groupe professionnel central, le personnel de manœuvre y apporte une contribution essentielle. Un environnement de travail innovant vous attend, dans lequel vous évoluerez aux CFF avec vos coéquipiers, ainsi que des formations variées et rémunérées. Vous disposez également de diverses opportunités de formation interne. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. descriptionByLocale.it: Polizia: in polizia di trasporto 50-100% | FFS - - - - - - Sposta la Svizzera con noi. Polizia: in polizia di trasporto Basilea, d'ora in poi o d'accordo, 50-100 % Applicare ora ## Non vedo l'ora. Alla base strategicamente importante di Basilea, stiamo cercando diversi agenti di polizia come parte di un set-up. Rafforzate la squadra esistente e assicuratevi che le persone si sentano al sicuro nei trasporti pubblici con il lavoro di polizia cittadino-friendly. Invece della routine amministrativa, l'attenzione è sulla missione vicino all'azione – attraverso i confini cantonali e incorporato in un team forte e apprezzativo. Le condizioni di lavoro interessanti sono importanti per noi – anche per ore di lavoro irregolari. Grazie a periodi di riposo chiaramente regolamentati e solo alcuni servizi notturni, il lavoro e la vita privata possono essere ben riconciliati presso la Polizia di Trasporto delle FFS. Scegli il tuo carico di lavoro in modo flessibile tra il 40-100%, un requisito di residenza non esiste. Il lavoro notturno e il fine settimana è inoltre pagato, ad esempio CHF 16.- all'ora per il lavoro di domenica e supplementi di tempo del 10-30% per gli incarichi notturni. Ulteriori vantaggi, come il libero GA 2a classe, assegni per bambini e viaggi scontati in patria e all'estero – anche per la tua famiglia possono essere trovati sotto “Benefits”. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di ufficiale di polizia: nelle FFS di Polizia dei Trasporti, insieme a più di 200 colleghi, si garantisce la sicurezza, la pace e l'ordine nelle stazioni ferroviarie e nei trasporti pubblici da varie compagnie di trasporto in tutta la Svizzera. - Il vostro focus è sui servizi di pattugliamento uniformati in mezzi di trasporto, stazioni e sulle aree delle compagnie di trasporto. - Nel tuo ruolo, contribuisci significativamente alla sicurezza dei viaggiatori e del personale dei trasporti pubblici. - Nel caso di interventi di polizia, si assume responsabilità nel team e in collaborazione con le organizzazioni partner – anche in occasioni importanti. - Voi lavorate sulla situazione e siete sempre sull'impulso di ciò che accade nei trasporti pubblici. - Siete attivamente coinvolti nella costruzione del team e formarlo attivamente. Lo porti con te. - Come giocatore di squadra: apprezzi la cooperazione a livello degli occhi e contribuisci attivamente alla squadra. - Agite apertamente, rispettosamente e professionalmente e incontrate i clienti con una forte comprensione dei servizi. - Lei ha il passaporto federale agente di polizia: in io così come la polizia solida conoscenza tattica e tecnica. - Molto buone abilità tedesche orali e scritte ti distinguono; La conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale è un vantaggio. - Si utilizzano strumenti digitali in modo sicuro e responsabile e utilizzarli in modo mirato nell'uso quotidiano. ## La tua ricompensa e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale equo e progressivo e siamo attivamente impegnati a parità di retribuzione. Per questo motivo, ulteriori e dettagliate informazioni sul sistema salariale possono essere visualizzate in modo trasparente presso le FFS. Questo lavoro è nel livello di requisito H, Regional Allowance Livello 1. ## Questo è il punto di partenza. Il fatto che si desidera spostare la Svizzera con noi è la più grande motivazione per noi. Pertanto, ci asteniamo da una lettera di motivazione a questo punto. Se volete ancora dirci la vostra motivazione, avete ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di applicazione. Fare il grande è più facile per te. Questo inizia con la tua applicazione. ## E' cosi' che va. × Al più tardi 10 giorni lavorativi dopo aver ricevuto l'applicazione, riceverai un feedback iniziale da noi. Policeman:in Transport Police 50-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Policeman:in Transportpolizei Basel, from now on or by appointment, 50-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to that. At the strategically important base in Basel, we are looking for several police officers as part of a set-up. You strengthen the existing team and ensure that people feel safe in public transport with citizen-friendly police work. Instead of administrative routine, the focus is on the mission close to the action – across cantonal borders and embedded in a strong, appreciative team. Attractive working conditions are important to us – even for irregular working hours. Thanks to clearly regulated rest periods and only a few night services, work and private life can be well reconciled with the SBB Transport Police. You choose your workload flexibly between 40-100%, a residence requirement does not exist. Night and weekend work is additionally remunerated, e.g. with CHF 16.- per hour for Sunday work and time surcharges of 10-30% for night assignments. Further benefits such as free GA 2nd class, child allowances and discounted travel at home and abroad - also for your family you can find under "Benefits". You can move that. - As a police officer: in the Transport Police SBB, together with more than 200 colleagues, you ensure security, peace and order in train stations and public transport from various transport companies throughout Switzerland. - Your focus is on uniformed patrol services in means of transport, railway stations and the areas of transport companies. In your role, you make a significant contribution to the safety of travellers and public transport staff. - In the case of police interventions, you carry responsibility in the team and in cooperation with partner organisations – even on major events. - You work situation-oriented and are always on the pulse of what is happening in public transport. - When building the team, you are actively involved and actively shape it. You bring that with you. - As a team player: you value cooperation at eye level and actively contribute to the team. - You act openly, respectfully and professionally and meet customers with a strong understanding of services. - You have the federal passport Police Officer: in I as well as sound police tactical and technical knowledge. - Very good oral and written German skills distinguish you; Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. You use digital tools safely and responsibly and use them in a targeted way in everyday use. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. This job is in requirement level H, Regional Allowance Level 1. ## This is the starting point. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. Therefore, we refrain from a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Making big is easier with you. This starts with your application. ## Continue like this. × At the latest 10 working days after receipt of the application, you will receive an initial feedback from us. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Still questions? For the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #simplyYou FAQ to apply For Job ID 103617 Michael Bigler, Chief Base Olten Telephone +41 79 876 95 69 Applications by e-mail can unfortunately not be considered. For this position, we do not accept dossiers from recruiters. ##
• We offer that. Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to reconciling your professional life with your private life. Read more Read more Differences Welcome Differences Welcome Read more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Learn More Learn More Career and Development Career and Development Learn More We promote our employees according to their personal needs and ambitions. For this purpose, we provide a wide range of interdisciplinary and cross-divisional training offers. In selected external training, we participate financially and temporally. Find out more about it

descriptionByLocale.fr: Officier de police : dans la police des transports 50-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Officier de police:à la police des transports de Bâle, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 50-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Nous recherchons plusieurs policiers dans le cadre d'un projet de construction sur la base stratégiquement importante de Bâle. Vous renforcerez l'équipe existante et veillerez à ce que les gens se sentent en sécurité dans les transports publics grâce à la police de proximité. Au lieu de la routine administrative, l'accent est mis sur des opérations proches de l'action – au-delà des frontières cantonales et au sein d'une équipe solide et reconnaissante. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires irréguliers. Grâce à des temps de repos clairement réglementés et à quelques équipes de nuit seulement, travail et vie privée peuvent être facilement conciliés à la Police des Transports des CFF. Vous pouvez choisir votre charge de travail de manière flexible entre 40 et 100 %, il n'y a aucune obligation d'avoir un lieu de résidence. Le travail de nuit et de week-end est rémunéré en supplément, par ex. B. avec 16 CHF de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche ainsi que des majorations de temps de 10 à 30 % pour les équipes de nuit. D’autres avantages tels que l’AG 2e classe gratuite, les allocations familiales et les voyages à prix réduits en Suisse et à l’étranger – vous les trouverez également pour votre famille sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que policier de la police des transports des CFF, vous et plus de 200 collègues dans toute la Suisse veillez à la sécurité, à la tranquillité et à l'ordre dans les gares et les transports publics auprès de différentes entreprises de transport. - Votre attention se porte sur les services de patrouille en uniforme dans les moyens de transport, les gares et sur les zones des entreprises de transport. - Dans votre rôle, vous apportez une contribution significative à la sécurité des voyageurs et du personnel des transports publics. - Lors des interventions policières, vous serez responsable de l'équipe et en collaboration avec les organismes partenaires - même lors d'événements majeurs. - Vous travaillez de manière orientée situation et êtes toujours à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics. - Vous participerez activement à la constitution de l'équipe et à sa formation. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - En tant qu'esprit d'équipe, vous appréciez travailler ensemble sur un pied d'égalité et contribuer activement à l'équipe. - Vous apparaissez ouvert, respectueux et professionnel et rencontrez des clients avec une solide compréhension du service. - Vous possédez le brevet d'officier de la Police fédérale I ainsi que des connaissances tactiques et techniques policières approfondies. - Vous vous caractérisez par de très bonnes compétences en allemand à l'oral et à l'écrit ; La connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale est un avantage. - Vous utilisez les outils numériques de manière sûre et responsable et les utilisez de manière ciblée dans les opérations quotidiennes. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Zugverkehrsleiter:in behältst du das dir zugeteilte Streckennetz im Blick, lenkst und überwachst die Züge an deinem Arbeitsplatz mit rund acht Bildschirmen. Im Normalbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr, steuerst die Abläufe und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Bei Störungen übernimmst du das operative Management: Du analysierst die Situation, leitest Massnahmen ein und behebst die Störung, damit der Normalzustand schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird. Damit trägst du die Mitverantwortung für die Mobilität der Schweiz. Ohne dich steht das Netz still. Der Job ist systemrelevant und unmittelbar wirkungsvoll: Du koordinierst Mensch und Technik, triffst rasche Entscheidungen und leistest so einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit des Bahnverkehrs.
Wir bieten dir eine bezahlte Zweitausbildung zur Zugverkehrsleiterin oder zum Zugverkehrsleiter, die acht Monate dauert. Nach erfolgreicher Abschlussprüfung bist du in der Betriebszentrale in Olten tätig und hilfst dabei, dass 9000 Personen- und 2000 Güterzüge täglich sicher und pünktlich ihr Ziel erreichen.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Infoveranstaltung .
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Sonntagsarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland – auch für die Familie – findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.

- 01. Februar 2027
- 01. Juni 2027

Das kannst du bewegen.

- Im Regelbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr; bei Störungen handelst du ruhig und effizient, leitest sofort Massnahmen ein und stellst den Normalbetrieb wieder her.
- Bei Störungen leitest du Massnahmen ein, damit der Normalzustand wiederhergestellt wird.
- Du koordinierst und kommunizierst mit Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen, Lokpersonal sowie Bau- und Rangierpersonal.
- Du verantwortest die Kundeninformation an Bahnhöfen und sorgst für klare, zeitnahe Mitteilungen.
- Dank deinem Einsatz sind Personen- und Güterzüge rund um die Uhr sicher und pünktlich unterwegs.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du bist zuverlässig, arbeitest gerne im Team und bist bereit, im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb zu arbeiten.
- Du denkst strukturiert und vernetzt. In Stresssituationen handelst du schnell und überlegt. Die technische Affinität wird in der Ausbildung gefördert.

- Du hast eine mindestens dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- In Deutsch bist du auf Niveau C2 sicher unterwegs und bringst idealerweise Französisch auf Niveau A1 mit. Ausserdem verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn ohne Rot-Grün-Schwäche.
- Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir von dir einen aktuellen Strafregister- und Betreibungsregisterauszug (nicht älter als 3 Monate) verlangen. Das Dokument kann bei der Einladung zum persönlichen Kennenlernen bestellt werden.

Die Einstufung während der Zweitausbildung erfolgt entsprechend der Funktion und dem Alter. Mehr zum konkreten Lohn für diese Rolle findest du unter Quereinstieg .

Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.

descriptionByLocale.it: Gestore circolazione treni ingresso laterale: al 100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale: a Olten, previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria tieni d'occhio la rete di tratte che ti è stata assegnata, dirigi e monitori i treni sul posto di lavoro con circa otto schermi. Durante il normale funzionamento monitorate il traffico, controllate i processi e assicurate che tutto proceda senza intoppi. In caso di interruzioni assumete la gestione operativa: analizzate la situazione, avviate misure e risolvete l'interruzione affinché la normalità venga ripristinata il più rapidamente possibile. Ciò significa che condividete la responsabilità della mobilità in Svizzera. Senza di te Internet si ferma. Il lavoro è rilevante per il sistema ed è immediatamente efficace: coordini persone e tecnologia, prendi decisioni rapide e quindi contribuisci direttamente alla sicurezza e all'affidabilità del trasporto ferroviario. Ti offriamo una formazione secondaria retribuita per diventare responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, della durata di otto mesi. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, lavorerai presso la centrale operativa di Olten e contribuirai a garantire che ogni giorno 9.000 treni passeggeri e 2.000 treni merci arrivino a destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e domenicale paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. I vantaggi come AG gratuita e viaggi all'estero scontati - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce Vantaggi. Possibili date di inizio: - 1 febbraio 2027 - 1 giugno 2027 - 1 ottobre 2027 Puoi far sì che ciò accada. - In qualità di responsabile del traffico ferroviario, tieni d'occhio la rete di percorsi che ti è stata assegnata, dirigi i treni in modo sicuro ed ecologico e monitori il traffico. - Durante il normale funzionamento osservi il traffico; In caso di interruzioni, agite con calma ed efficienza, intervenite immediatamente e ripristinate la normale operatività. - In caso di interruzioni, si adottano misure per ripristinare la normalità. - Coordini e comunichi con i compagni di squadra, il personale delle locomotive, nonché il personale di costruzione e di manovra. - Sei responsabile delle informazioni sui clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie e garantisci comunicazioni chiare e tempestive. - Grazie al vostro impegno i treni passeggeri e merci viaggiano in sicurezza e puntuali 24 ore su 24. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei affidabile, ti piace lavorare in team e sei disposto a lavorare su turni 24 ore su 24. - Pensi in modo strutturato e in rete. Nelle situazioni stressanti agisci rapidamente e con attenzione. L'affinità tecnica viene promossa durante la formazione. - Per il periodo di formazione intensivo e impegnativo, porti molta responsabilità personale e volontà di apprendere e sei motivato a farti coinvolgere in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni frontali in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. - Avere completato almeno tre anni di formazione professionale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Hai familiarità con il tedesco al livello C2 e idealmente hai il francese al livello A1. Hai anche un perfetto senso del colore senza debolezza rosso-verde. - Durante la procedura di richiesta ti chiederemo di fornire un estratto aggiornato del tuo casellario giudiziale e del registro delle esecuzioni (non più vecchio di 3 mesi). Il documento può essere ordinato quando siete invitati a conoscervi di persona. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. descriptionByLocale.en:
Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Olten, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work at the operations center in Olten and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start dates: - February 1st, 2027 - June 1st, 2027 - October 1st, 2027 You can make this happen. - As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operation you observe the traffic; In the event of disruptions, you act calmly and efficiently, take immediate action and restore normal operations. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You are confident in German at level C2 and ideally have French at level A1. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? For the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application About the position Job ID 103618 Jasmin Schärer, team leader train traffic controllers in training +41 79 846 37 79 Christoph Hartung, team leader train traffic controllers in training +41 79 563 08 49 Applications by email unfortunately cannot be taken into account. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

En tant que responsable du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué, dirigez et surveillez les trains sur votre lieu de travail avec environ huit écrans. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. En cas de perturbations, vous prenez en charge la gestion opérationnelle : vous analysez la situation, engagez des mesures et résolvez la perturbation afin que la normalité revienne le plus rapidement possible. Cela signifie que vous partagez la responsabilité de la mobilité en Suisse. Sans vous, Internet s’arrête. Le travail est pertinent pour le système et immédiatement efficace : vous coordonnez les personnes et la technologie, prenez des décisions rapides et contribuez ainsi directement à la sécurité et à la fiabilité du transport ferroviaire. Im Normalbetrieb beobachtest du den Verkehr, steuerst die Abläufe und sorgst so für einen reibungslosen Ablauf. Bei Störungen übernimmst du das operative Management: Du analysierst die Situation, leitest Massnahmen ein und behebst die Störung, damit der Normalzustand schnellstmöglich wiederhergestellt wird. descriptionByLocale.it: Gestore circolazione treni ingresso laterale: al 100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Responsabile del traffico ferroviario con ingresso laterale: a Muttenz, previo accordo, 100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, tieni d'occhio la rete di tratte che ti è stata assegnata nello scalo di smistamento di Basilea, dirigi e monitori i treni sul posto di lavoro con circa sei-otto schermi. Inoltre è possibile impostare le diverse corse di manovra e dei treni tramite una pulsantiera. Durante il normale funzionamento monitorate il traffico, controllate i processi e assicurate che tutto proceda senza intoppi. In caso di interruzioni assumete la gestione operativa: analizzate la situazione, avviate misure e risolvete l'interruzione affinché la normalità venga ripristinata il più rapidamente possibile. Ciò significa che condividete la responsabilità della mobilità in Svizzera. Senza di te Internet si ferma. Il lavoro è rilevante per il sistema ed è immediatamente efficace: coordini persone e tecnologia, prendi decisioni rapide e quindi contribuisci direttamente alla sicurezza e all'affidabilità del trasporto ferroviario. Ti offriamo una formazione secondaria retribuita per diventare responsabile della circolazione ferroviaria, della durata di otto mesi. Dopo aver superato con successo l'esame finale, lavorerai nello scalo di smistamento di Basilea e contribuirai a garantire che 2000 treni merci arrivino ogni giorno a destinazione in modo sicuro e puntuale. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e domenicale paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. Ti coordinerai inoltre con i gestori del traffico ferroviario per il trasporto merci transfrontaliero. - Sei responsabile delle informazioni sui clienti nelle stazioni ferroviarie e garantisci comunicazioni chiare e tempestive. - Grazie al vostro impegno i treni passeggeri e merci viaggiano in sicurezza e puntuali 24 ore su 24. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei affidabile, ti piace lavorare in team e sei disposto a lavorare su turni 24 ore su 24. - Pensi in modo strutturato e in rete. Nelle situazioni stressanti agisci rapidamente e con attenzione. L'affinità tecnica viene promossa durante la formazione. - Per il periodo di formazione intensivo e impegnativo, porti molta responsabilità personale e volontà di apprendere e sei motivato a farti coinvolgere in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni frontali in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. - Avere completato almeno tre anni di formazione professionale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Hai familiarità con il tedesco al livello C2 e idealmente hai il francese al livello A1. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Muttenz, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you in the Basel marshalling yard, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around six to eight screens. In addition, you can set the various shunting and train journeys using a push-button signal box. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the Basel marshalling yard and help ensure that 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start dates: - February 1st, 2027 - June 1st, 2027 - October 1st, 2027 You can make this happen. - As a train traffic manager in the Basel marshalling yard, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operations, you ensure that the international transits of freight trains (Germany – France) are carried out smoothly. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel in Switzerland. You will also coordinate with the train traffic managers for cross-border freight transport. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You are confident in German at level C2 and ideally have French at level A1. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. En cas de perturbations, vous prenez en charge la gestion opérationnelle : vous analysez la situation, engagez des mesures et résolvez la perturbation afin que la normalité revienne le plus rapidement possible. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB Cargo bist du am Puls der Schweizer Wirtschaft. SBB Cargo transportiert täglich 170.000 Tonnen und entlastet damit die Straße um 15.000 LKW-Fahrten pro Tag und die Umwelt jährlich um 460.000 Tonnen CO2. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB Cargo bewegst. Zudem erhältst du eine abwechslungsreiche und bezahlte Ausbildung im Rangierbahnhof. Darüber hinaus stehen dir verschiedene Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten wie die Ausbildung zum/zur Rangierlokführer:inn offen.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmäßigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - zum Beispiel mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge zwischen 10 und 30%. Das bedeutet, dass du mehr Freizeit hast als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Rangierspezialist:in trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zuverlässig und pünktlich bedient werden, indem du Güterzüge auf ihre Fahrt vorbereitest.
- Du übernimmst die Wagen, führst Sicherheitskontrollen durch und bereitest den Zug durch komplexe Rangierbewegungen für die nächste Fahrt vor.
- Du erfasst die notwendigen Daten für die Zugführung mit persönlichen, modernen IT-Geräten (z.B. Tablet).
- Durch das rechtzeitige Zu- und Abstellen der Wagen beim Kunden hast du täglich direkten Kundenkontakt. Du nimmst ihre Rückmeldungen entgegen und leitest sie bei Bedarf an die zuständige Stelle weiter.

Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Quereinstieg Lokführer:in Personenverkehr Ziegelbrücke 12/2026
Ziegelbrücke, 01.12.2026, 100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Als Lokführer:in machst du Grosses: Bei SBB Personenverkehr bewegst du jährlich rund 508 Millionen Reisende. Nach Abschluss der bezahlten 15-monatigen Zweitausbildung führt dich der Job entlang der schönsten Bahnstrecken der Schweiz. Dabei bringst du unsere Fahrgäste pünktlich an ihr Ziel und sorgst so für ein positives Reiseerlebnis mit der SBB.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, da du deine Freizeit geniessen kannst, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht. Ausserdem kannst du nach der Ausbildung zum:zur Lokführer:in dein Pensum nach Rücksprache individuell ab 60 Prozent gestalten, wobei dir unterschiedliche Teilzeitmodelle zur Verfügung stehen.
Erfahre mehr zum Berufsbild an der nächsten Informationsveranstaltung .
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Lokführer:in übernimmst du nicht nur die Spitze des Zugs, sondern auch Verantwortung für Sicherheit und Pünktlichkeit auf dem dicht befahrenen Schienennetz.
- Während deiner Fahrt bist du achtsam und reagierst schnell und richtig auf Signale, Geschwindigkeitsregelungen sowie unvorhersehbare Ereignisse.
- Du handelst selbstständig und stehst jederzeit mit Betriebszentralen und Leitstellen in Kontakt.
- Neben dem Führen und Rangieren der Züge gehört auch das Überprüfen des technischen Zustands vor und nach der Übernahme des Fahrzeugs zu deinen Aufgaben.
- Dank dem exakt getakteten Dienstplan kannst du pünktlich und ohne weitere Aufgaben oder Mails in den wohlverdienten Feierabend.
Das bringst du mit.
- Herausforderungen gehst du gelassen an, triffst auch in stressigen Situationen überlegte Entscheidungen und bringst Bereitschaft für Schichtarbeit mit.
- Für die intensive und anspruchsvolle Ausbildungszeit bringst du viel Eigenverantwortung und Motivation mit und bist bereit, dich auf unterschiedliche Lernumgebungen einzulassen – von Präsenzunterricht vor Ort bis zum digitalen Selbststudium.
- Du hast eine dreijährige Berufslehre oder die Matura abgeschlossen. Deine Motivation ist uns dabei wichtiger als die Branche, aus der du kommst.
- Du bist verhandlungssicher in Deutsch (Niveau C2) und bringst Anfängerkenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache (Niveau A1) mit.
- Aus Sicherheitsgründen verfügst du über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot-Grün-Schwäche). Zudem weist du keine Einträge im Straf- und Betreibungsregister auf.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Die Einstufung während der Zweitausbildung erfolgt entsprechend der Funktion und dem Alter. Mehr zum konkreten Lohn für diese Rolle findest du unter Quereinstieg .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria di 15 mesi, il lavoro ti porta lungo le più belle linee ferroviarie in Svizzera. Porti i nostri passeggeri a destinazione in tempo e quindi garantisci un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con FFS. Vedi orari di lavoro irregolari e lavoro a turni come un vantaggio, poiché puoi goderti il tuo tempo libero mentre altri lavorano. Cross-input Locomotive driver:in passenger service Brick bridge 12/2026 100%, SBB - - - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Cross-input Locomotive driver:in passenger service Brick bridge 12/2026 Brick bridge, 01.12.2026, 100% Apply now

As a train driver: you do big things: With SBB passenger services you travel about 508 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job leads you along the most beautiful railway lines in Switzerland. You bring our passengers to their destination on time and thus ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. You see irregular working hours and shiftwork as an advantage, since you can enjoy your free time while others work. Night and weekend work are additionally remunerated with us, e.g.

With an hourly wage supplement of 16 francs for Sunday work. In night operations you get time increases of 10 to 30%, which allows you to have more leisure time. You can also, after training for:to the driver:in your workload, individually design from 60 percent after consultation, whereby different part-time models are available to you. Learn more about the job picture at the next information event.

- As a driver: you take responsibility for safety and punctuality on the densely run rail network, not only for the top of the train. - During your journey you are careful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unpredictable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operating centres and control stations at any time. - In addition to guiding and shunting the trains, checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle is also part of your tasks.

- Thanks to the precisely documented schedule, you can make informed decisions and make a willingness for shiftwork on time and without further tasks or emails. - You can bring this along. - Challenges you tackle with ease, also in stressful situations, and also make thoughtful decisions and bring readyness for shiftwork. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you contribute a lot of personal responsibility and motivation and are ready to engage in different learning environments – from classroom lessons on site to digital self-study.

Lateral entry train traffic manager: in 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train traffic manager: in Zurich Airport or Limmattal marshalling yard, by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct and monitor the trains at your workplace with around eight screens. During normal operation, you monitor the traffic, control the processes and ensure that things run smoothly. In the event of disruptions, you take over operational management: you analyze the situation, initiate measures and resolve the disruption so that normality is restored as quickly as possible. This means you share responsibility for mobility in Switzerland. Without you the internet comes to a standstill. The job is system-relevant and immediately effective: you coordinate people and technology, make quick decisions and thus make a direct contribution to the safety and reliability of rail transport.
• We offer you paid secondary training to become a train traffic manager, which lasts eight months. After successfully completing your final exam, you will work in the operations center at Zurich Airport or in the Limmattal marshalling yard and help ensure that 9,000 passenger and 2,000 freight trains reach their destination safely and on time every day. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and Sunday work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. Possible start date: - March 1, 2027 - July 1, 2027 - November 1, 2027 You can move this. - As a train traffic manager, you keep an eye on the route network assigned to you, direct trains safely and ecologically and monitor traffic. - During regular operation you observe the traffic; In the event of disruptions, you act calmly and efficiently, take immediate action and restore normal operations. - In the event of disruptions, you take measures to restore normality. - You coordinate and communicate with teammates, locomotive personnel as well as construction and shunting personnel. - You are responsible for customer information at train stations and ensure clear, timely communications. - Thanks to your efforts, passenger and freight trains travel safely and on time around the clock. This is what you bring with you. - You are reliable, enjoy working in a team and are willing to work 24-hour shifts. - You think in a structured and networked way. In stressful situations you act quickly and carefully. Technical affinity is promoted during training. - For the intensive and demanding training period, you bring a lot of personal responsibility and willingness to learn and are motivated to get involved in different learning environments - from face-to-face lessons on site to digital self-study. - You have completed at least three years of vocational training or a high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - In German you are confident at level C2. You also have a perfect sense of color with no red-green weakness. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Responsable du trafic ferroviaire à entrée latérale: à l'aéroport de Zurich ou à la gare de triage de Limmattal, sur rendez-vous, 100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. En tant que responsable du trafic ferroviaire, vous surveillez le réseau de lignes qui vous est attribué, dirigez et surveillez les trains sur votre lieu de travail avec environ huit écrans. En fonctionnement normal, vous surveillez le trafic, contrôlez les processus et veillez au bon déroulement des opérations. En cas de perturbations, vous prenez en charge la gestion opérationnelle : vous analysez la situation, engagez des mesures et résolvez la perturbation afin que la normalité revienne le plus rapidement possible. Cela signifie que vous partagez la responsabilité de la mobilité en Suisse. Sans vous, Internet s’arrête. Le travail est pertinent pour le système et immédiatement efficace : vous coordonnez les personnes et la technologie, prenez des décisions rapides et contribuez ainsi directement à la sécurité et à la fiabilité du transport ferroviaire. Nous vous proposons une formation secondaire rémunérée pour devenir gestionnaire du trafic ferroviaire, d'une durée de huit mois. Après avoir réussi votre examen final, vous travaillerez au centre opérationnel de l'aéroport de Zurich ou dans la gare de triage de Limmattal et contribuerez à ce que 9 000 trains de voyageurs et 2 000 trains de marchandises arrivent chaque jour à destination en toute sécurité et à temps. Découvrez-en davantage sur le profil de carrière lors du prochain événement d’information. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et le dimanche, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels que l'AG gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes fiable, aimez travailler en équipe et êtes prêt à travailler 24 heures sur 24. - Vous réfléchissez de manière structurée et en réseau. Dans les situations stressantes, vous agissez rapidement et prudemment. L'affinité technique est favorisée lors de la formation. - Pour la période de formation intensive et exigeante, vous apportez beaucoup de responsabilités personnelles et de volonté d'apprendre et êtes motivé pour vous impliquer dans différents environnements d'apprentissage - des cours en présentiel sur place à l'auto-apprentissage numérique. - Vous avez complété au moins trois années de formation professionnelle ou un diplôme d'études secondaires. Votre motivation est plus importante pour nous que le secteur dont vous êtes issu. - En allemand vous êtes confiant au niveau C2. Vous avez également un sens parfait de la couleur, sans aucune faiblesse rouge-vert. - Lors du processus de candidature, nous vous demanderons de fournir un extrait à jour de votre casier judiciaire et du registre des poursuites (datant de moins de 3 mois). Le document peut être commandé lorsque vous êtes invités à faire connaissance personnellement. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. La classification lors de la deuxième formation est basée sur la fonction et l'âge. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le salaire spécifique pour ce rôle sous entrée latérale. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience in Erstfeld, from now on or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started.
