## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Auf dich wartet ein spannendes, innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du grosse Veränderungen antreiben kannst und so zur Digitalisierung der SBB beiträgst. Bei UHR (Unterhalt Rollmaterial) wirst du eine Schlüsselposition im Werk Olten haben, mit vielen Aufgaben, Verantwortungen, um unsere Kunden mit deinem vollen Einsatz zu unterstützen. Gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkollegen erarbeitest du Lösungswege für aktuelle Herausforderungen und setzt diese im Team um. Auch Weiterbildungen kommen für die individuelle Berufsentwicklung nicht zu kurz.
Im Werk Olten arbeitest du aktuell im Zweischichtbetrieb von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 04.45 Uhr und 17.45 Uhr.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Rangierspezialist:in bewegst du unter Anleitung des Manöverkoordinators Reise- und Güterzugwagen.
- In dein Tätigkeitsgebiet gehört u.a. das An- und Abhängen der verschiedenen Wagen und die Bedienung der Handweichen sowie dem Stellwerk. Dabei arbeitest du nach den Fahrdiendienstvorschriften und den vorgeschriebenen Standards der SBB.
- Inbetriebnahmen von und fahren mit Trieb- und Gliederzügen gehören ebenfalls in deinen Aufgabenbereich.
- Du fährst mit Rangierlokomotiven, Zweiwegefahrzeugen, führst Bremsproben durch und erstellst die Fahrbereitschaft. Zudem bist du für den Kleinunterhalt der Fahrzeuge zuständig.
- Kundenzufriedenheit ist eines unserer obersten Ziele. Für unsere Kunden bist du täglich im Einsatz. Du lebst unsere Sicherheitskultur und wendest den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) konstant an.
Das bringst du mit.
- Damit du diese verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe erfolgreich wahrnehmen kannst, bist du geistig und körperlich fit und in guter Verfassung.
- Du zeichnest dich durch dein vernetztes Denken und Handeln, deine Belastbarkeit, deine Selbstständigkeit sowie deine Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, aus.
- Ausgeprägtes Teamplay sowie eine überdurchschnittlich hohe Kunden- und Qualitätsorientierung sind weitere Attribute, die deinen Charakter gut beschreiben.
- Für die anspruchsvolle Position benötigst du eine abgeschlossene Grundausbildung EFZ, idealerweise als Logistiker:in Verkehr oder eine ähnliche Ausbildung in handwerklicher/technischer Richtung.
- Du verfügst idealerweise über eine Ausbildung und Erfahrung im Rangierdienst, verbunden mit fahrdienstlichem Begleiten gemäss BAV Ausweis VTE A40 direkt. Alternativ bist du Rangierbegleiter:in Ai40 indirekt und bringst die Bereitschaft zur Ausbildung VTE A40 direkt mit.
- Du bringst gute schriftliche und mündliche Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch mit (mindestens Niveau B2).

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau E, Regionalzulage Stufe 0. Train driver: in shunting or shunting specialist: in Olten, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. An exciting, innovative working environment awaits you in which you can drive big changes and thus contribute to the digitalization of SBB. At UHR (maintenance rolling stock) you will have a key position in the Olten plant, with many tasks and responsibilities in order to support our customers with your full commitment. Together with your teammates, you will develop solutions to current challenges and implement them as a team. Further training is also not neglected for individual professional development. At the Olten plant you are currently working in two shifts from Monday to Friday between 4:45 a.m. and 5:45 p.m. You can move that. - As a shunting specialist, you move passenger and freight train cars under the guidance of the maneuver coordinator. - Your area of ​​activity includes, among other things, attaching and detaching the various wagons and operating the manual switches and the signal box. You work in accordance with the transport service regulations and the prescribed standards of the SBB. - Commissioning and driving multiple units and articulated trains are also part of your area of ​​responsibility. - You drive shunting locomotives, road-rail vehicles, carry out brake tests and ensure that they are ready to drive. You are also responsible for the small maintenance of the vehicles. - Customer satisfaction is one of our top goals. You work for our customers every day. You live our safety culture and constantly apply the continuous improvement process (CIP). This is what you bring with you. - In order for you to be able to carry out this responsible task successfully, you must be mentally and physically fit and in good shape. - You are characterized by your networked thinking and actions, your resilience, your independence and your willingness to take responsibility. - Strong team play as well as an above-average customer and quality orientation are further attributes that describe your character well. - For the demanding position, you need to have completed basic EFZ training, ideally as a logistics specialist in transport or similar training in a craft/technical direction. - Ideally, you have training and experience in shunting, combined with driving accompaniment in accordance with the BAV ID card VTE A40 direct. Alternatively, you are an Ai40 shunting attendant indirectly and are willing to take part in VTE A40 training. - You have good written and oral language skills in German (at least level B2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. Conducteur de train : en manœuvres ou spécialiste des manœuvres : à Olten, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100 % Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Un environnement de travail passionnant et innovant vous attend dans lequel vous pouvez conduire de grands changements et ainsi contribuer à la numérisation des CFF. Chez UHR (maintenance du matériel roulant), vous occuperez un poste clé au sein de l'usine d'Olten, avec de nombreuses tâches et responsabilités afin d'accompagner nos clients avec votre plein engagement. Avec vos coéquipiers, vous développerez des solutions aux défis actuels et les mettrez en œuvre en équipe. La formation continue n’est pas non plus négligée pour le développement professionnel individuel. À l'usine d'Olten, vous travaillez actuellement en deux équipes du lundi au vendredi entre 4h45 et 17h45. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que spécialiste des manœuvres, vous déplacez des wagons de voyageurs et de marchandises sous la direction du coordonnateur des manœuvres. - Votre domaine d'activité comprend entre autres l'attelage et le détachement des différents wagons ainsi que la manoeuvre des interrupteurs manuels et du poste de signalisation. Vous travaillez conformément aux prescriptions relatives aux services de transport et aux normes prescrites par les CFF. - La mise en service et la conduite d'unités multiples et de trains articulés font également partie de votre domaine de responsabilité. - Vous conduisez des locomotives de manœuvre, des véhicules rail-route, effectuez des tests de freinage et vous assurez qu'ils sont prêts à rouler. Vous êtes également responsable du petit entretien des véhicules. - La satisfaction du client est l'un de nos principaux objectifs. Vous travaillez chaque jour pour nos clients. Vous vivez notre culture de sécurité et appliquez constamment le processus d’amélioration continue (CIP). C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Pour que vous puissiez mener à bien cette tâche responsable, vous devez être en bonne forme mentale et physique. - Vous vous caractérisez par votre réflexion et vos actions en réseau, votre résilience, votre indépendance et votre volonté de prendre des responsabilités. - Un fort esprit d'équipe ainsi qu'une orientation client et qualité supérieure à la moyenne sont d'autres attributs qui décrivent bien votre caractère. - Pour le poste exigeant, vous devez avoir suivi une formation de base EFZ, idéalement en tant que logisticien dans le transport ou une formation similaire dans un sens artisanal/technique. - Idéalement, vous disposez d'une formation et d'une expérience en manœuvres, combinées à un accompagnement à la conduite conformément à la carte d'identité BAV VTE A40 direct. Alternativement, vous êtes indirectement opérateur de manœuvre Ai40 et souhaitez participer à la formation VTE A40. - Vous disposez de bonnes compétences linguistiques écrites et orales en allemand (au moins niveau B2). ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Schichtleiter:in Transport
Oensingen, 01.09.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung, 60-100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB Cargo bist du am Puls der Schweizer Wirtschaft. SBB Cargo transportiert täglich 185.000 Tonnen und entlastet damit die Straße um 15.000 LKW-Fahrten pro Tag und die Umwelt jährlich um 460.000 Tonnen CO2. Auf dich wartet ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem du gemeinsam mit deinen Teamkolleginnen und Teamkollegen die SBB Cargo bewegst.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits .
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Schichtleiter:in verantwortest du, während der dir zugewiesenen Schicht die operative Leitung und vertrittst in dieser Zeit den:die Teamleiter:in.
- Im Team bist du für das operative Management von Personal, Zügen und Fahrzeugen verantwortlich. Du machst Funktionsanweisungen und weist diese nach Bedarf der Gruppe zu, die in deinem Verantwortungsbereich liegt.
- Du sorgst dafür, dass die Sicherheitsregeln und Prozesse, sowie für Pünktlichkeit und Sicherheit bei der Vorbereitung von Zügen in deinem Bereich, eingehalten werden.
- Bei Abweichungen ergreifst du eigenständig Massnahmen, um die Auswirkungen auf Kunden und Betrieb möglichst gering zu halten.
- Du vertrittst die Interessen der SBB Cargo im Störfall. Anhand deiner Beobachtungen gibst du wichtige Hinweise zur Verbesserung der Prozesse und des Ressourceneinsatzes.
Das bringst du mit.
- Du arbeitest gerne im Team und respektierst die verschiedenen Persönlichkeiten, du arbeitest selbstständig und findest schnell, auch in schwierigen Situationen, eine gute Lösung. Du engagierst dich aktiv für die Sicherheit deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen und bist ein Vorbild im Alltag.
- Du verfügst über umfassende soziale und berufliche Kompetenzen. Du schätzst es, in unvorhergesehenen Situationen Entscheidungen zu treffen.
- Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung auf dem Gebiet des Rangiers sowie eine gute Beherrschung der Landessprache sind erforderlich.
- Ein sicherer Umgang mit Office 365 ist für dich selbstverständlich, ebenso wie die Anwendung der Arbeitszeitbestimmungen des GAV und des AZG.
- Du hast viel Erfahrung im Bereich des Rangierens.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau G, Regionalzulage Stufe Keine Regionalzulage. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

descriptionByLocale.it: Capoturno: nei trasporti 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Capoturno: a Transport Oensingen, 1 settembre 2026 o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Con FFS Cargo avete il polso dell'economia svizzera. FFS Cargo trasporta ogni giorno 185.000 tonnellate, riduce il carico sulle strade di 15.000 viaggi di camion al giorno e riduce l'impatto sull'ambiente di 460.000 tonnellate di CO2 ogni anno. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo in cui voi e i vostri collaboratori potrete far progredire FFS Cargo. Consideri l'orario di lavoro irregolare e il lavoro a turni come un vantaggio per goderti il ​​tempo libero mentre gli altri lavorano. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, ad esempio per il lavoro domenicale una paga oraria supplementare di 16 franchi. Per i turni notturni ricevi un'indennità dal 10 al 30%, che ti dà più tempo libero. I vantaggi come AG gratuita e viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce Vantaggi. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di capoturno, sei responsabile della gestione operativa durante il turno che ti è stato assegnato e rappresenti il ​​caposquadra durante questo periodo. - Nel team sei responsabile della gestione operativa del personale, dei treni e dei mezzi. Fornisci istruzioni funzionali e le assegni secondo necessità al gruppo che è la tua area di responsabilità. - Ti assicuri che le regole e i processi di sicurezza, nonché la puntualità e la sicurezza, siano rispettati durante la preparazione dei treni nella tua zona. - In caso di deviazioni, agirai in modo indipendente per mantenere il più basso possibile l'impatto sui clienti e sulle operazioni. - In caso di incidente rappresentate gli interessi di FFS Cargo. Sulla base delle tue osservazioni, fornisci informazioni importanti su come migliorare i processi e l'utilizzo delle risorse. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Ti piace lavorare in squadra e rispettare le diverse personalità, lavori in modo indipendente e trovi rapidamente una buona soluzione, anche in situazioni difficili. Ti impegni attivamente per la sicurezza dei tuoi colleghi e sei un modello nella vita di tutti i giorni. - Possiedi competenze sociali e professionali complete. Apprezzi prendere decisioni in situazioni impreviste. - Sono richieste una formazione professionale completa o un'esperienza professionale pluriennale nel settore delle manovre, nonché una buona padronanza della lingua locale. - L'utilizzo sicuro di Office 365 è per voi una cosa ovvia, così come l'applicazione delle norme sull'orario di lavoro della GAV e dell'AZG. - Hai molta esperienza nelle manovre. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito G, livello di indennità regionale Nessuna indennità regionale. Maggiori informazioni su retribuzione e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione definitiva entro un mese dal ricevimento della domanda Domanda Decisione definitiva entro un mese dal ricevimento della domanda Domande? Informazioni sul processo di candidatura Supporto Recruiting FFS Telefono + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu Domande frequenti sulla candidatura Alla posizione Job ID 103071 Rico Lohse, team leader Telefono +41 79 687 12 65 Purtroppo non è possibile prendere in considerazione candidature via e-mail. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Shift manager: in transport 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Shift manager: in Transport Oensingen, September 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - As a shift leader, you are responsible for operational management during the shift assigned to you and represent the team leader during this time. - In the team you are responsible for the operational management of personnel, trains and vehicles. You make functional instructions and assign them as needed to the group that is your area of ​​responsibility. - You ensure that safety rules and processes, as well as punctuality and safety, are adhered to when preparing trains in your area. - If there are deviations, you will take action independently to keep the impact on customers and operations as low as possible. - You represent the interests of SBB Cargo in the event of an incident. Based on your observations, you provide important information on how to improve processes and the use of resources. This is what you bring with you. - You enjoy working in a team and respect different personalities, you work independently and quickly find a good solution, even in difficult situations. You are actively committed to the safety of your colleagues and are a role model in everyday life. - You have comprehensive social and professional skills. You value making decisions in unforeseen situations. - Completed vocational training or several years of professional experience in the field of shunting as well as a good command of the local language are required. - A secure use of Office 365 is a matter of course for you, as is the application of the working time regulations of the GAV and the AZG. - You have a lot of experience in maneuvering. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level G, regional allowance level No regional allowance. More about pay and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103071 Rico Lohse, team leader Telephone +41 79 687 12 65 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

descriptionByLocale.fr: Chef d'équipe : dans les transports 60-100% | CFF - - - - - - Déménagez en Suisse avec nous. Chef d'équipe : chez Transport Oensingen, le 1er septembre 2026 ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela avec impatience. Chez CFF Cargo, vous prenez le pouls de l'économie suisse. CFF Cargo transporte 185 000 tonnes par jour, réduisant ainsi la pollution routière de 15 000 déplacements de camion par jour et l'impact sur l'environnement de 460 000 tonnes de CO2 par an. Un environnement de travail innovant vous attend dans lequel vous et vos collaborateurs ferez avancer CFF Cargo. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels que l'AG gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que chef d'équipe, vous êtes responsable de la gestion opérationnelle pendant le quart de travail qui vous est assigné et représentez le chef d'équipe pendant cette période. - Au sein de l'équipe vous êtes responsable de la gestion opérationnelle du personnel, des trains et des véhicules. Vous réalisez des instructions fonctionnelles et les assignez selon les besoins au groupe qui est votre domaine de responsabilité. - Vous veillez au respect des règles et processus de sécurité, ainsi que de ponctualité et de sécurité lors de la préparation des trains sur votre territoire. - En cas d'écarts, vous prendrez des mesures de manière indépendante pour maintenir l'impact sur les clients et les opérations aussi bas que possible. - Vous représentez les intérêts de CFF Cargo en cas d'incident. Sur la base de vos observations, vous fournissez des informations importantes sur la manière d'améliorer les processus et l'utilisation des ressources. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous aimez travailler en équipe et respectez les différentes personnalités, vous travaillez de manière autonome et trouvez rapidement une bonne solution, même dans des situations difficiles. Vous vous engagez activement pour la sécurité de vos collègues et êtes un modèle au quotidien. - Vous disposez de compétences sociales et professionnelles complètes. Vous appréciez prendre des décisions dans des situations imprévues. - Une formation professionnelle complète ou plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine des manœuvres ainsi qu'une bonne maîtrise de la langue locale sont requises. - Une utilisation sécurisée d'Office 365 est une évidence pour vous, tout comme l'application des réglementations sur le temps de travail du GAV et de l'AZG. - Vous avez beaucoup d'expérience en manœuvres. ## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux. Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence G, niveau d'allocation régionale Aucune allocation régionale. En savoir plus sur la rémunération et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature. Faire de grandes choses est plus facile si vous le faites vous-même. descriptionByLocale.it: Ingresso laterale come macchinista: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 Goldau, 1 marzo 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Decisione finale Domanda Decisione finale Domande? Informazioni sul processo di candidatura Supporto Recruiting FFS Telefono + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu Domande frequenti sulla candidatura Alla posizione ID lavoro 103244 Stefan Lüthi, Responsabile della formazione Regione Centrale Telefono +41 512 81 87 64 Purtroppo non è possibile prendere in considerazione candidature via e-mail. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Goldau, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103244 Stefan Lüthi, Training Manager Central Region Telephone +41 512 81 87 64 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Macchinista con ingresso laterale: nel trasporto passeggeri 03/2027 Zugo, 1 marzo 2027, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Come macchinista fai grandi cose: presso il Trasporto viaggiatori FFS muovi ogni anno circa 482 milioni di passeggeri. Dopo aver completato la formazione secondaria retribuita di 15 mesi, il lavoro vi porterà lungo le tratte ferroviarie più belle della Svizzera. Portate puntualmente i nostri passeggeri a destinazione e assicurate loro un'esperienza di viaggio positiva con le FFS. Anche la vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è piena di prospettive con condizioni interessanti per tutte le situazioni della vita. Per il lavoro notturno e fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni è previsto anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Inoltre, dopo la formazione per diventare macchinista, dopo aver consultato voi potete organizzare individualmente il vostro carico di lavoro a partire dal 60% e avete a disposizione diversi modelli di lavoro part-time. Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di macchinista non assumi solo la guida del treno, ma anche la responsabilità della sicurezza e della puntualità sulla trafficata rete ferroviaria. - Durante il viaggio sii consapevole e reagisci rapidamente e correttamente ai segnali, ai controlli di velocità e agli eventi imprevedibili. - Agisci in modo indipendente e sei sempre in contatto con i centri operativi e di controllo. - Oltre alla guida e alla manovra dei treni, i tuoi compiti comprendono anche il controllo delle condizioni tecniche prima e dopo la presa in consegna del veicolo. Scopri di più sul profilo professionale al prossimo evento informativo. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Aver completato un tirocinio triennale o un diploma di scuola superiore. Per noi la tua motivazione è più importante del settore da cui provieni. - Affronti le sfide con calma, prendi decisioni ben ponderate anche in situazioni di stress e sei disposto a lavorare a turni. - Parli correntemente il tedesco (livello C2) e hai una conoscenza base del francese (livello A1). - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni. - Hai molta responsabilità personale e motivazione per il periodo di formazione intenso ed impegnativo e sei disposto a essere coinvolto in diversi ambienti di apprendimento, dalle lezioni in aula in loco allo studio autonomo digitale. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry as train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in passenger transport 03/2027 Zug, March 1st, 2027, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a train driver, you do great things: at SBB Passenger Transport you move around 482 million passengers every year. After completing the paid 15-month secondary training, the job will take you along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. You get our passengers to their destination on time and ensure a positive travel experience with SBB. Your everyday working life is also full of prospects with attractive conditions for all life situations. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work – for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you also have a time surcharge of between 10 and 30 percent. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. In addition, after training to become a train driver, you can individually design your workload from 60 percent after consultation, with different part-time models available to you. You can move that. - As a train driver, you not only take on the lead of the train, but also responsibility for safety and punctuality on the busy rail network. - During your journey you are mindful and react quickly and correctly to signals, speed controls and unforeseeable events. - You act independently and are in contact with operations centers and control centers at all times. - In addition to driving and maneuvering trains, your tasks also include checking the technical condition before and after taking over the vehicle. Find out more about the career profile at the next information event. This is what you bring with you. - You have completed a three-year apprenticeship or high school diploma. Your motivation is more important to us than the industry you come from. - You approach challenges calmly, make well-considered decisions even in stressful situations and are willing to work shifts. - You are fluent in German (level C2) and have beginner's knowledge of French (level A1). - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. - You have a lot of personal responsibility and motivation for the intensive and demanding training period and are willing to get involved in different learning environments - from on-site classroom lessons to digital self-study. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103243 Stefan Lüthi, Training Manager Central Region Telephone +41 512 81 87 64 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. En tant que conducteur de train, vous faites de grandes choses : chez Transport de voyageurs CFF, vous transportez chaque année environ 482 millions de voyageurs. Après une formation secondaire rémunérée de 15 mois, le poste vous emmènera sur les plus belles routes ferroviaires de Suisse. Vous amenez nos passagers à destination à temps et garantissez une expérience de voyage positive avec les CFF. Votre vie professionnelle quotidienne est également pleine de perspectives avec des conditions attractives pour toutes les situations de la vie. Nous versons un salaire supplémentaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end – par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Il controllo della sicurezza sul lavoro e la redazione di reportistica completano l'attività. - Inoltre, sarai impiegato come macchinista per i treni edili in cantiere e saranno richieste le tue competenze tecniche. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience 100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Rapperswil SG, October 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You will complete your theoretical training in Olten and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and dismantle them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 103144 Fabian Heuberger, team leader Telephone +41 79 713 70 75 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Du möchtest einen Job, in dem jeder deiner Handgriffe zählt? Bei der SBB hast du die Chance, dein Können einzubringen und gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten anzueignen, die dich beruflich bereichern und weiterbringen.
Du hast eine Berufslehre im mechanischen-handwerklichen Bereich abgeschlossen und möchtest in einem spannenden und innovativen Arbeitsumfeld etwas bewegen, das Sinn macht? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
Wir suchen an diesen Standorten der Deutschschweiz Unterstützung: Zürich, Sargans, Brugg, Rapperswil, Winterthur und Gossau SG.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche im Fitnesscenter trainieren, in der Badi die Sonne geniessen, einkaufen ohne anstehen – einfach deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten. Pikett, Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet. Je nach Einsätzen zahlen wir zusätzlich zwischen 300 und 700 CHF pro Monat. Zudem erhältst du 10-30% Zeitzuschläge. Das bedeutet, du kannst diese Zeitzuschläge mit Freizeit kompensieren. Unsere weiteren Benefits wie Kinderzulagen, kostenloses 2. Klasse GA und vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter « Benefits ».
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Du suchst eine spannende, vielfältige und abwechslungsreiche Aufgabe, mit der du einen wertvollen Beitrag für die Kundinnen und Kunden der SBB leisten kannst? Grosse und moderne Maschinen begeistern dich ebenso wie verantwortungsvolle und komplexe Aufgaben.
- In deiner neuen Funktion kümmerst du dich, abhängig von deiner Qualifikation und deinem Know-how, um den Bau, Unterhalt und die Instandhaltung der bahntechnischen Anlagen wie Fahrleitungen, Gleise, Weichen, Barrieren, Signale oder Zugsicherungssysteme. Es handelt sich hierbei um eine Pool-Ausschreibung für sämtliche Stellen im oben erwähnten Bereich. Anhand deiner Fähigkeiten, Erfahrungen und Ausbildungen ermitteln wir die bestgeeignete Einstiegsmöglichkeit für dich. Mehr zu unseren spannenden Berufsbildern findest du: hier .
- Als Teamplayer hilfst du mit, dass Störungen schnell lokalisiert und behoben werden. Du packst gerne mit an und hast Freude daran, zu jeder Jahreszeit im Freien zu arbeiten. Im Team meisterst du anspruchsvolle, hauptsächlich mechanische/handwerkliche Arbeiten an unseren Anlagen. Damit leistest du einen wertvollen Beitrag, sodass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden pünktlich und sicher an ihr Ziel gelangen.
- Unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten (teilweise auch am Wochenende) und/oder Schichtarbeit siehst du als Vorteil für deine flexible Freizeitgestaltung.
Das bringst du mit.
- Ein hohes Verantwortungs- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein ist für dich selbstverständlich. Teamwork und Gemeinschaft sind dir genauso wichtig wie uns. In unserer Branche sind Teamplayer der Schlüssel zum gemeinsamen Erfolg.
- Du packst gerne mit an und bist neuen digitalen Hilfsmitteln gegenüber offen. Sich kontinuierlich weiterzubilden ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du freust dich auf interne Aus- und Weiterbildungen bei vollem Lohn.
- Du hast eine abgeschlossene mechanische-handwerkliche Grundausbildung EBA oder EFZ (Produktionsmechaniker:in, Polymechaniker:in, Landmaschinenmechaniker:in, allgemeiner Mechaniker:in, Schlosser:in in der Baubranche oder ähnliche Berufe, z. B. Landschaftsgärtner:in).
- Damit du Pikettdienst leisten kannst, besitzt du einen Führerausweis der Kategorie B. Ein uneingeschränktes Hör- und Sehvermögen sowie eine gute Gesundheit setzen wir voraus.

Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau D, Regionalzulage Stufe 2. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.

Cambio di carriera: nel mondo delle professioni meccaniche e artigianali nella Svizzera tedesca, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Do you want a job where every move you make counts? At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. Have you completed an apprenticeship in the mechanical and craft sector and would you like to make a difference in an exciting and innovative working environment? Then you've come to the right place! We are looking for support in these locations in German-speaking Switzerland: Zurich, Brugg, Rapperswil and Winterthur. You can train in the fitness center during the week, enjoy the sun in the swimming pool, go shopping without queuing - simply make your free time more flexible. We pay additional compensation for on-call, night and weekend work. Depending on the assignments, we pay an additional between 300 and 700 CHF per month. You also receive 10-30% time bonuses. This is a pool advertisement for all positions in the above-mentioned area. Based on your skills, experience and training, we will determine the most suitable entry opportunity for you. In doing so, you make a valuable contribution to ensuring that our customers reach their destination safely and on time. - You see irregular working hours (sometimes on weekends) and/or shift work as an advantage for your flexible leisure activities. This is what you bring with you. - A high sense of responsibility and safety is a given for you. Teamwork and community are just as important to you as they are to us. In our industry, team players are the key to shared success. - You like to lend a hand and are open to new digital tools. Continuous training is a given for you. Officier de police: à la base de la police des transports de Zurich, le 1er juillet 2025 ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Pour notre base de Zurich, nous recherchons des policiers engagés et motivés qui souhaitent se consacrer à un poste passionnant et varié. Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. Nous travaillons également régulièrement avec d'autres corps de police et organismes partenaires, ce qui élargira votre réseau. Faites partie d'une équipe appréciée, dynamique et motivée qui veille à la sécurité et à l'ordre au-delà des frontières du canton. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Insieme ai tuoi compagni di squadra, svilupperai soluzioni alle sfide attuali e le implementerai come una squadra. Anche la formazione continua non viene trascurata per il vostro sviluppo individuale. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Ma potrete usufruire delle piste da sci gratuite durante la settimana e organizzare il vostro tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Caposquadra: nella costruzione di binari nella Svizzera tedesca, da ora in poi o previo accordo, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Alle FFS avete la possibilità di mettere a frutto le vostre competenze e allo stesso tempo di acquisirne di nuove che arricchiranno e faranno progredire la vostra carriera. Non esageri quando dici che senza di te la Svizzera è ferma! In qualità di caposquadra vi assicurate che il traffico ferroviario si svolga senza intoppi nell'area operativa della filiale. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Ma puoi goderti le piscine vuote durante la settimana e organizzare il tuo tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Riceverai anche indennità di tempo. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - In questo ruolo sei responsabile dei lavori di manutenzione, lavori superficiali e di ingegneria civile nell'area stradale. - Il controllo della corretta esecuzione dei lavori e del rispetto delle misure di sicurezza è a vostro carico. - Ti assumerai la direzione di diversi cantieri e la gestione tecnica dei dipendenti. - Il team supporta anche la preparazione e la rendicontazione del lavoro. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei indipendente, un giocatore di squadra e resiliente e ti piace dare una mano. - Hai una buona salute con udito e vista senza limitazioni. - Il presupposto è un tirocinio professionale come costruttore di vie di comunicazione o un tirocinio professionale riconosciuto dalla SEFRI con orientamento artigianale (tre anni) ed EFZ, nonché il potenziale e la volontà di perfezionarsi come caposquadra. Richiediamo che tu sia disposto a lavorare con orari irregolari e ad essere reperibile per questa posizione. Vous n'exagérez pas lorsque vous dites que la Suisse reste immobile sans vous ! En tant que contremaître, vous veillez au bon déroulement du trafic ferroviaire dans la zone d'exploitation de la succursale. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Mais vous pouvez profiter de piscines vides en semaine et organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Vous recevrez également des allocations de temps. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes indépendant, joueur d'équipe et résilient et aimez donner un coup de main. - Vous êtes en bonne santé et disposez d'une audition et d'une vision sans restriction. - Un apprentissage professionnel de constructeur de voies de circulation ou un apprentissage professionnel reconnu par le SEFRI avec orientation artisanale (trois ans) et EFZ est une condition préalable, ainsi que le potentiel et la volonté de se perfectionner en tant que contremaître. Nous exigeons que vous soyez prêt à travailler selon des horaires irréguliers et que vous soyez de garde pour ce poste. Auf dich wartet eine abwechslungsreiche, bezahlte 9-monatige Vollzeitausbildung. Die theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du in Olten oder in Zürich und deine ersten Praxiserfahrungen sammelst du in einem regional zugeteilten Rangierbahnhof.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits und mehr Infos zum Beruf findest du hier.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Als Lokführerin oder Lokführer Bauzüge leistest du einen grossen Beitrag, um die Erneuerungen der Trassen (Gleise, Schotter usw.) sicherzustellen.

Lateral entry train driver: in construction train with manual experience Olten, May 1st, 2026 or by arrangement, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. A varied, paid 9-month full-time training program awaits you. You complete your theoretical training in Olten or Zurich and gain your first practical experience in a regionally assigned marshalling yard. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can move that. - As a train driver for construction trains, you make a big contribution to ensuring the renewal of the routes (tracks, gravel, etc.). - You carry out and carry out various and complex shunting movements of trains up to a maximum of 100 km/h independently, form and disassemble them and prepare them for the journey. - In order to ensure regional logistics, you draft, apply for and order driving orders on time and are responsible for supplying construction sites with the necessary materials. - You have a high level of responsibility for the operational safety of the construction trains. Checking workplace safety and creating reports round off the activities. - In addition, you will be deployed as a train driver for construction trains on the construction site and your technical skills will be required. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are conscientious, reliable, a team player and willing to work in 24-hour shifts. - You are physically and mentally resilient and can act consciously and correctly with your independent way of working. - You have at least two years of recognized vocational training including a certificate of skills, ideally in the construction industry and with experience in track construction or have completed your high school diploma. - Fluent written and spoken German (level C1) is a prerequisite. - You have a category B driving license. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. Guardiano di sicurezza con ingresso laterale / capo della sicurezza Winterthur, da ora in poi o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Puoi aspettarti questo. In qualità di guardia di sicurezza, ti assicuri che i lavori nell'area della pista siano svolti in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle misure di sicurezza. La vostra vita lavorativa quotidiana è tanto varia quanto i vostri orari di lavoro e i diversi luoghi in cui viaggiate lungo le più belle tratte ferroviarie della Svizzera. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. descriptionByLocale.en: Lateral entry security guard / head of security 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Lateral entry security guard / head of security Winterthur, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. As a safety guard, you ensure that work in the track area is carried out safely and in compliance with safety measures. Your everyday working life is just as varied as your working hours and the different locations you travel along the most beautiful railway routes in Switzerland. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can move that. - You are responsible for protecting staff, materials and equipment from the dangers of railway operations and traction power systems. - As a security guard, you warn colleagues at the railway construction site about approaching trains. - You are responsible for setting up and implementing a security system and communicating directly by telephone or radio with the responsible authorities. - You inform those responsible for the construction site about any unusual incidents that have been identified in their area of ​​activity. - You travel a lot and carry out this activity at different locations in your region. More about the job description here. This is what you bring with you. - For this demanding work, you are prepared to work independently, reliably, as a team player and openly, in shifts (early morning, day, night and weekend shifts). - You are physically and mentally resilient and have a strong sense of security. - Ideally, you have completed basic training (EBA / EFZ) or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. You have completed your training as a security guard or head of security or are ready to complete it. - You are skilled at using various digital work tools (iPad and iPhone) and applications and are willing to continually educate yourself and learn. - Your fluent German skills round off your profile. Knowledge of a second national language is desirable. - A valid category B driving license (passenger car with manual transmission) and good eyesight and hearing complete your profile. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Application Final decision up to one month after receipt of application Any questions? We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. descriptionByLocale.en: Automation engineer, electrical engineer or electrical installer in the field of interlocking technology 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Automation engineer, electrical engineer or electrical installer in the field of signal box technology Brugg AG, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. We will train you to become a specialist for complex electrical interlocking systems. In this way, you can make a significant contribution to ensuring that our customers have highly available and secure signaling and automation systems at all times. In internal training courses you will be intensively and professionally prepared for your future role. There is also the opportunity to continually develop yourself and take on tasks with more responsibility. An ambitious and motivated team is looking forward to a new team member. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can find our benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits. You can move that. - In your role, you independently carry out construction and maintenance activities on the railway electrical systems, primarily indoors. - You will be actively involved in economically ensuring the reliability, availability and safety of the railway infrastructure systems. - You provide on-call duty to resolve faults in the complex systems and ensure their availability. - Depending on the respective project, you will work sporadically at night and on weekends. Of course, these hours worked will also be rewarded accordingly. - So that you can successfully carry out this important function, you will undergo two years of part-time internal training. We train you so that you can independently locate and resolve faults in the indoor systems. This is what you bring with you. - You are a technically savvy personality, independent and proactive and are always flexible in your way of working for the tasks involved. - For this position you need a completed 4-year basic electrical engineering training EFZ (automatic engineer, electrical engineer, electrician or related professions). - The prerequisite for taking up the position is good hearing and vision so that you can recognize important acoustic and visual signals when working in the track area. - For this position you need a category B driving license. Ideally, you live in the Brugg region so that you can be at the location within around 30 minutes during on-call duty. - We expect very good oral and written German skills (B2-C2). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level F, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision approx. 6 weeks after receipt of application Application Final decision approx. 6 weeks after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone +41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 96797 Andreas Wölfli Telephone +41 79 503 91 26 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Ingénieur en automatisation, ingénieur électricien ou installateur électricien dans le domaine de la technologie des boîtes de signalisation Brugg AG, dès maintenant ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en attendre avec impatience. Nous vous formerons pour devenir un spécialiste des systèmes de verrouillage électriques complexes. De cette manière, vous pouvez contribuer de manière significative à garantir à nos clients des systèmes de signalisation et d’automatisation hautement disponibles et sécurisés à tout moment. Lors des formations internes, vous serez préparé de manière intensive et professionnelle à votre futur rôle. Il y a aussi la possibilité de se développer continuellement et d'assumer des tâches avec plus de responsabilités. Une équipe ambitieuse et motivée attend avec impatience un nouveau membre. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Für unseren Stützpunkt in St. Gallen suchen wir engagierte und motivierte Polizist:innen, die sich einer spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Stelle widmen möchten. Bei uns steht nicht die Büroarbeit im Vordergrund, sondern die bürgernahe Polizeiarbeit am Puls des Geschehens im öffentlichen Verkehr mit einem klaren Fokus auf die sicherheitspolizeilichen Aufgaben. Zudem arbeiten wir regelmässig mit anderen Polizeikräften und Partnerorganisationen zusammen, was dein Netzwerk erweitern wird. Werde Teil eines wertschätzenden, dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das über die Kantonsgrenzen hinaus für Sicherheit und Ordnung sorgt.
Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig, auch bei unregelmässigen Arbeitszeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet - z.B. mit 16 Franken pro Stunde für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du zudem Zeitzuschläge von zwischen 10 und 30%. Das heisst, du hast mehr Freizeit als Mitarbeitende ohne Nacht- und Wochenendeinsätze.

- Du leistest uniformierte und auch zivile Präsenz in Transportmitteln, in Bahnhöfen und auf dem Areal der Transportunternehmen.
- Dabei trägst du zum Schutz und zur Sicherheit unserer Reisenden und des Personals des öffentlichen Verkehrs bei.
- Mit polizeilichen Interventionen, auch zusammen mit Partnerorganisationen, übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Sicherheit und Ordnung.
- Zu den spannenden Herausforderungen gehören auch Einsätze in Eventzügen und an Grossanlässen im Einsatzgebiet Schweiz.
Das bringst du mit.
