descriptionByLocale.it: Agente di polizia: nella polizia dei trasporti 60-100% | FFS - - - - - - Muovete la Svizzera con noi. Agente di polizia presso la base della polizia dei trasporti di San Gallo, da subito o su appuntamento, 60-100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Per la nostra sede di San Gallo cerchiamo agenti di polizia impegnati e motivati ​​che vogliano dedicarsi a un posto entusiasmante e vario. Per noi l’attenzione non è sul lavoro d’ufficio, ma sulla polizia di prossimità, al passo con ciò che accade nel trasporto pubblico, con una chiara attenzione ai compiti della polizia di sicurezza. Collaboriamo regolarmente anche con altre forze di polizia e organizzazioni partner, che amplieranno la tua rete. Entrate a far parte di un team riconoscente, dinamico e motivato che garantisce la sicurezza e l'ordine oltre i confini del cantone. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Paghiamo salari aggiuntivi per il lavoro notturno e nei fine settimana, ad es. 16 franchi all'ora per il lavoro domenicale. Per i turni notturni riceverete anche un supplemento orario compreso tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Gli altri nostri vantaggi come gli assegni per i figli, l'AG gratuito in 2a classe e i viaggi scontati all'estero - anche per la famiglia - potete trovarli sul nostro sito web alla voce "Vantaggi". Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di agente della Polizia dei trasporti FFS, tu e oltre 190 colleghi garantite la sicurezza, la tranquillità e l'ordine nelle stazioni ferroviarie e sui trasporti pubblici di diverse aziende di trasporto. - Presti una presenza in uniforme e civile sui mezzi di trasporto, nelle stazioni ferroviarie e nei locali delle aziende di trasporto. - Contribuisci alla protezione e alla sicurezza dei nostri viaggiatori e del personale dei trasporti pubblici. - Con gli interventi della polizia, anche insieme alle organizzazioni partner, ti assumi la responsabilità della sicurezza e dell'ordine. - Le sfide entusiasmanti comprendono anche l'impiego nei treni degli eventi e in occasione di grandi eventi nell'area operativa svizzera. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Sei una personalità orientata al servizio, aperta e vincente, poiché sei a contatto quotidiano con i nostri clienti. - Per noi il lavoro di squadra è la chiave del successo. Sei un giocatore di squadra e non vedi l'ora di lavorare insieme come una squadra. - Possiedi il certificato di ufficiale di polizia federale I e hai buone conoscenze tattiche e tecniche di polizia. - Sei caratterizzato da un'ottima espressione orale e scritta in lingua tedesca. La conoscenza di una seconda lingua nazionale costituisce titolo preferenziale. - Possiedi inoltre buone conoscenze informatiche e amministrative, che puoi utilizzare in modo orientato agli obiettivi. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. Abbiamo un sistema salariale giusto e progressivo e ci impegniamo attivamente per garantire la parità retributiva. Pertanto è possibile visualizzare in modo trasparente ulteriori informazioni dettagliate sul sistema salariale delle FFS. Questa posizione è al livello di requisito H, livello di indennità regionale 0. Maggiori informazioni su salari e benefici. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Questo inizia con la tua domanda. ## Ecco come continua. × Riceverai un feedback iniziale da parte nostra entro e non oltre 10 giorni lavorativi dal ricevimento della domanda. Non accettiamo dossier dai reclutatori per questa posizione. ## Questo è ciò che offriamo. Vantaggi Vantaggi Scopri di più Ove possibile, puntiamo su orari di lavoro flessibili e modelli di orario di lavoro moderni. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Scopri di più Scopri di più Differenze benvenute Differenze benvenute Scopri di più Con oltre 150 professioni diverse, offriamo un'impressionante varietà di opportunità di ingresso e di sviluppo. I nostri dipendenti sono altrettanto diversi. Ecco perché ci impegniamo a garantire che tutti i dipendenti possano contribuire con i propri punti di forza e modi di pensare individuali. Per saperne di più Per saperne di più Carriera e sviluppo Carriera e sviluppo Per saperne di più Sosteniamo i nostri dipendenti in base alle loro esigenze e ambizioni personali. A tal fine, forniamo un’ampia gamma di corsi di formazione interdisciplinari e interdipartimentali. Contribuiamo finanziariamente e temporalmente a selezionati corsi di perfezionamento esterni. descriptionByLocale.en: Police officer: in transport police 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Police officer at the St. Gallen transport police base, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. For our base in St. Gallen, we are looking for committed and motivated police officers who would like to dedicate themselves to an exciting and varied position. For us, the focus is not on office work, but on community policing at the pulse of what is happening in public transport with a clear focus on security police tasks. We also work regularly with other police forces and partner organizations, which will expand your network. Become part of an appreciative, dynamic and motivated team that ensures security and order beyond the canton's borders. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you and over 190 colleagues will ensure safety, peace and order in the train stations and on public transport from various transport companies. - You provide a uniformed and civilian presence in means of transport, in train stations and on the premises of the transport companies. - You contribute to the protection and safety of our travelers and public transport staff. - With police interventions, also together with partner organizations, you take responsibility for security and order. - The exciting challenges also include deployments in event trains and at major events in the Swiss operational area. This is what you bring with you. - You are a service-oriented, open and winning personality, as you are in daily contact with our customers. - For us, teamwork is the key to success. You are a team player and look forward to working together as a team. - You have the federal police officer I certificate and have good police tactical and technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written expression in the German language. Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You also have good IT and administrative knowledge, which you can use in a goal-oriented manner. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 0. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision Application Final decision Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 99425 Alexander Tönz Telephone +41 79 876 86 42 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Find out more Find out more

Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. descriptionByLocale.en: Police officer: in transport police 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Police officer at the Winterthur transport police base, from now on or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. For our new office in Winterthur, we are looking for committed and motivated police officers who would like to dedicate themselves to an exciting and varied position. For us, the focus is not on office work, but on community policing at the pulse of what is happening in public transport with a clear focus on security police tasks. We also work regularly with other police forces and partner organizations, which will expand your network. Become part of an appreciative, dynamic and motivated team that ensures security and order beyond the canton's borders. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - e.g. 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts, you also receive time surcharges of between 10 and 30%. This means you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. You can find our other benefits such as child allowances, free 2nd class GA and discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under “Benefits”. You can move that. - As a police officer in the SBB transport police, you will ensure safety, peace and order with over 190 colleagues in the train stations and on public transport from various transport companies. - You provide a uniformed and civilian presence in means of transport, in train stations and on the premises of the transport companies. - You contribute to the protection and safety of our travelers and public transport staff. - With police interventions, also together with partner organizations, you take responsibility for security and order. - The exciting challenges also include deployments in event trains and at major events in the Swiss operational area. This is what you bring with you. - You are a service-oriented, open and winning personality, as you are in daily contact with our customers. - For us, teamwork is the key to success. You are a team player and look forward to working together as a team. - You have the federal police officer I certificate and have good police tactical/technical knowledge. - You are characterized by very good oral and written expression in the German language. Knowledge of a second national language is an advantage. - You also have good IT/administrative skills that you can use in a goal-oriented manner. ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level H, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to 6 weeks after receipt of application Application Final decision up to 6 weeks after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 98770 Philipp Kröbl, base manager Email: philipp.kroebl@sbb.ch Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Officier de police à la base de la police des transports de Winterthur, désormais ou sur rendez-vous, 60-100% Postulez maintenant ## Vous pouvez vous en réjouir. Pour notre nouveau bureau de Winterthour, nous recherchons des policiers engagés et motivés qui souhaitent se consacrer à un poste passionnant et varié. Pour nous, l'accent n'est pas mis sur le travail de bureau, mais sur une police de proximité à l'écoute de ce qui se passe dans les transports publics, en mettant clairement l'accent sur les tâches de police de sécurité. Nous travaillons également régulièrement avec d'autres corps de police et organismes partenaires, ce qui élargira votre réseau. Faites partie d'une équipe appréciée, dynamique et motivée qui veille à la sécurité et à l'ordre au-delà des frontières du canton. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons des salaires supplémentaires pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par ex. 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les équipes de nuit, vous bénéficiez également de majorations de temps comprises entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Vous trouverez nos autres avantages tels que les allocations familiales, l'AG de 2e classe gratuite et les voyages à l'étranger à prix réduits - également pour la famille - sur notre site Internet sous « Avantages ». Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant qu'officier de police des transports des CFF, vous assurez la sécurité, la tranquillité et l'ordre avec plus de 190 collègues dans les gares et dans les transports publics de différentes entreprises de transport. - Vous assurez une présence en uniforme et civile dans les moyens de transport, dans les gares et dans les locaux des entreprises de transport. - Vous contribuez à la protection et à la sécurité de nos voyageurs et du personnel des transports publics. - Avec les interventions de la police, également en collaboration avec des organisations partenaires, vous assumez la responsabilité de la sécurité et de l'ordre. - Les défis passionnants incluent également les déploiements dans des trains événementiels et lors de grands événements dans le domaine opérationnel suisse. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes une personnalité orientée service, ouverte et gagnante, car vous êtes en contact quotidien avec nos clients. - Pour nous, le travail d'équipe est la clé du succès. Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe et avez hâte de travailler en équipe. - Vous êtes titulaire du brevet de policier fédéral I et possédez de bonnes connaissances tactiques/techniques policières. - Vous vous caractérisez par une très bonne expression orale et écrite en langue allemande. ## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der Intervention SBB bist du rund um die Uhr bereit für den Ernstfall. Über 80 moderne Einsatzfahrzeuge auf Schienen und Strassen sind dabei im Einsatz. Was macht diesen Beruf einzigartig? Du bist Bahnspezialist:in, Lokführer:in und Feuerwehrperson in einem. Du kümmerst dich bei einem Ereignis um die Sicherheit unserer Kundinnen und Kunden und trägst dazu bei, dass der Bahnverkehr schnellstmöglich wieder normal läuft. Attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen sind uns wichtig.
Das kannst du bewegen.
- Im Alarmfall sowie bei Übungen rückst du als Lokführer:in mit dem Lösch- und Rettungszug mit deinem Team aus und sorgst für die Sicherheit unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.
- Bei Zwischenfällen, welche den Bahnverkehr beeinträchtigen, bist du mitverantwortlich für den Schutz von Menschen, Tieren, Umwelt und Bahninfrastruktur.
- Vor Ort sorgst du für die Sicherheit aller Reisenden, bekämpfst Brände auf und neben den Schienen, leistest Öl- und Chemiewehr sowie technische Hilfe. Der Einsatz von Drohnen hilft dabei eine rasche Beurteilung der Lage zu erhalten.
- Du trainierst regelmässig die verschiedenen Arbeitsabläufe und -techniken, um jederzeit eine reibungslose Ereignisbewältigung sicherzustellen. Dabei stehst du von Montag bis Freitag im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb im Einsatz und leistest Pikett am Wochenende. Unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns die Regel. Dafür kannst du unter der Woche freie Skipisten geniessen und deine Freizeit flexibler gestalten.
Erfahre hier mehr zum Berufsbild.
Das bringst du mit.
- Dank deinem hohen Verantwortungs- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein verstehst du die Abhängigkeiten und Auswirkungen auf dein Team sowie deine Arbeit. Bei uns zählen Miteinander und Gemeinschaft im Team, auf das du dich jederzeit verlassen kannst. Dazu gehört, dass du gerne selbständig arbeitest und physisch und psychisch belastbar bist.
- Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre mit eidgenössischem Fähigkeitszeugnis (EFZ). Den Fahrausweis für Triebfahrzeuge der Kategorie B100 besitzt du bereits oder bringst die Bereitschaft mit, die entsprechende interne bezahlte Ausbildung zu absolvieren.
- Du besitzt einen Führerausweis der Kategorie B und idealerweise auch der Kategorie C1 118.
- Du verfügst über eine Atemschutztauglichkeit und hast Erfahrung als Feuerwehrperson.
- In der deutschen Sprache bist du verhandlungssicher (mündlich und schriftlich) und du bist bereit, ein Französisch-Diplom auf Niveau A1 zu absolvieren.
- Im Bewerbungsprozess werden wir von dir einen aktuellen Strafregister- und Betreibungsregisterauszug (nicht älter als 3 Monate) verlangen. Das Dokument kann bei der Einladung zum persönlichen Kennenlernen bestellt werden.

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Die Einstufung während der Zweitausbildung erfolgt entsprechend der Funktion und dem Alter. Mehr zum konkreten Lohn für diese Rolle findest du unter Quereinstieg .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Specialista in ingresso laterale: nel soccorso ferroviario Ostermundigen, 1 agosto 2026, 100% Candidati ora ## Non vedi l'ora. Con Intervento FFS siete pronti 24 ore su 24 in caso di emergenza. Oltre 80 moderni veicoli di emergenza sono in uso su rotaie e strade. Cosa rende unico questo lavoro? Sei uno specialista ferroviario, un macchinista e un pompiere tutto in uno. Garantirai la sicurezza dei nostri clienti durante un evento e contribuirai a garantire che il traffico ferroviario ritorni alla normalità il più rapidamente possibile. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti. Puoi spostarlo. - In caso di allarme o durante le esercitazioni, come macchinista sarai schierato con la tua squadra sul treno antincendio e di soccorso e garantirai la sicurezza dei nostri clienti. - In caso di incidenti che riguardano il traffico ferroviario, sei corresponsabile della protezione delle persone, degli animali, dell'ambiente e dell'infrastruttura ferroviaria. - Sul posto garantisci la sicurezza di tutti i viaggiatori, combatti gli incendi sui binari e in prossimità di essi, fornisci protezione da oli e sostanze chimiche e assistenza tecnica. L’uso dei droni aiuta a valutare rapidamente la situazione. - Ti alleni regolarmente sui vari processi e tecniche di lavoro per garantire una gestione degli eventi fluida in ogni momento. Lavorerai su turni di 24 ore dal lunedì al venerdì e sarai reperibile nel fine settimana. Per noi gli orari di lavoro irregolari sono la regola. Ma potrete usufruire delle piste da sci gratuite durante la settimana e organizzare il vostro tempo libero in modo più flessibile. Scopri di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te. - Grazie al tuo elevato senso di responsabilità e sicurezza, comprendi le dipendenze e gli effetti sulla tua squadra e sul tuo lavoro. Ciò che conta per noi è l’unione e la comunità in una squadra su cui puoi fare affidamento in qualsiasi momento. Ciò significa che ti piace lavorare in modo indipendente e sei fisicamente e mentalmente resistente. - Hai completato un tirocinio professionale con un certificato di capacità federale (EFZ). Possiedi già la patente di guida per locomotive della categoria B100 o sei disposto a completare la relativa formazione interna retribuita. - Possiedi una patente di guida della categoria B e idealmente anche della categoria C1 118. - Sei idoneo alla protezione respiratoria e hai esperienza come vigile del fuoco. - Parli fluentemente la lingua tedesca (orale e scritta) e sei pronto per completare un diploma di francese di livello A1. - Durante la procedura di richiesta ti chiederemo di fornire un estratto aggiornato del tuo casellario giudiziale e del registro delle esecuzioni (non più vecchio di 3 mesi). Il documento può essere ordinato quando siete invitati a conoscervi di persona. ## Il tuo stipendio e i tuoi benefici. La classificazione durante il secondo allenamento si basa sulla funzione e sull'età. Puoi scoprire di più sullo stipendio specifico per questo ruolo nella voce laterale. ## Con questo puoi iniziare. Il fatto che tu voglia spostare la Svizzera con noi è la nostra più grande motivazione. Ecco perché a questo punto non includiamo una lettera di motivazione. Se vuoi ancora comunicarci la tua motivazione, hai ancora la possibilità di farlo nel nostro strumento di candidatura. Fare grandi cose è più facile se lo fai da solo. Inoltre, come datore di lavoro, siamo flessibili anche quando si tratta di conciliare la vostra vita professionale con la vostra vita privata. Lateral entry specialist: in railway rescue Ostermundigen, August 1st, 2026, 100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. With SBB Intervention, you are ready around the clock in case of an emergency. Over 80 modern emergency vehicles are in use on rails and roads. What makes this job unique? You are a railway specialist, train driver and firefighter all in one. You will ensure the safety of our customers during an event and help ensure that rail traffic returns to normal as quickly as possible. Attractive working conditions are important to us. You can move that. - In the event of an alarm or during exercises, as a train driver you will be deployed with your team in the fire and rescue train and ensure the safety of our customers. - In the event of incidents that affect rail traffic, you are jointly responsible for the protection of people, animals, the environment and rail infrastructure. - On site you ensure the safety of all travelers, fight fires on and next to the tracks, provide oil and chemical protection and technical assistance. The use of drones helps to quickly assess the situation. - You regularly train the various work processes and techniques to ensure smooth event management at all times. You will work 24-hour shifts from Monday to Friday and will be on call at the weekend. Irregular working hours are the rule for us. But you can enjoy free ski slopes during the week and organize your free time more flexibly. Find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you. - Thanks to your high sense of responsibility and security, you understand the dependencies and effects on your team and your work. What counts for us is togetherness and community in a team that you can rely on at any time. This means that you enjoy working independently and are physically and mentally resilient. - You have completed a vocational apprenticeship with a federal certificate of proficiency (EFZ). You already have a driving license for locomotives in category B100 or are willing to complete the relevant internal paid training. - You have a category B and ideally also category C1 118 driving license. - You are suitable for respiratory protection and have experience as a firefighter. - You are fluent in the German language (orally and in writing) and you are ready to complete a French diploma at level A1. - During the application process, we will require you to provide a current extract from your criminal record and debt collection register (not older than 3 months). The document can be ordered when you are invited to get to know each other in person. ## Your salary and your benefits. Classification during the second training is based on function and age. You can find out more about the specific salary for this role under lateral entry. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. This starts with your application. ## This is how it continues. × You will receive initial feedback from us no later than 10 working days after receipt of your application. Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Application Final decision up to two months after receipt of application Any questions? About the application process SBB Recruiting Support Telephone + 41 51 220 20 29 recruiting@sbb.ch #einfachDu FAQ about the application To the position Job ID 102797 Philippe Weyeneth, Ostermundigen site manager Telephone +41 79 593 47 42 Unfortunately, applications by email cannot be considered. We do not accept dossiers from recruiters for this position. ## This is what we offer. Benefits Benefits Find out more Wherever possible, we rely on flexible working hours and modern working time models. In addition, as an employer, we are also flexible when it comes to balancing your professional life with your private life. Find out more Find out more Differences welcome Differences welcome Find out more With over 150 different professions, we offer an impressive variety of entry and development opportunities. Our employees are just as diverse. That is why we are committed to ensuring that all employees can contribute their individual strengths and ways of thinking. Find out more Find out more Career and development Career and development Find out more We support our employees based on their personal needs and ambitions. To this end, we provide a wide range of cross-disciplinary and cross-departmental training courses. We contribute financially and temporally to selected external further training courses. Avec Intervention CFF, vous êtes prêt 24 heures sur 24 en cas d'urgence. Plus de 80 véhicules d’urgence modernes sont utilisés sur les rails et sur les routes. Qu’est-ce qui rend ce métier unique ? Vous êtes à la fois spécialiste ferroviaire, conducteur de train et pompier. Vous assurerez la sécurité de nos clients lors d’un événement et contribuerez à ce que le trafic ferroviaire revienne à la normale le plus rapidement possible. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous. Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En cas d'alarme ou lors d'exercices, en tant que conducteur de train vous serez déployé avec votre équipe dans le train d'incendie et de secours et assurerez la sécurité de nos clients. - En cas d'incidents affectant le trafic ferroviaire, vous êtes solidairement responsables de la protection des personnes, des animaux, de l'environnement et des infrastructures ferroviaires. - Sur place vous veillez à la sécurité de tous les voyageurs, luttez contre les incendies sur et à proximité des voies, assurez la protection pétrolière et chimique et l'assistance technique. L’utilisation de drones permet d’évaluer rapidement la situation. - Vous formez régulièrement les différents processus et techniques de travail pour assurer à tout moment une gestion fluide des événements. Vous travaillerez 24 heures sur 24 du lundi au vendredi et serez de garde la fin de semaine. Les horaires de travail irréguliers sont la règle chez nous. Mais vous pouvez profiter des pistes de ski gratuites en semaine et organiser votre temps libre de manière plus flexible. Apprenez-en davantage sur le profil de poste ici. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Grâce à votre sens élevé des responsabilités et de la sécurité, vous comprenez les dépendances et les effets sur votre équipe et votre travail. Ce qui compte pour nous, c'est la convivialité et la communauté au sein d'une équipe sur laquelle vous pouvez compter à tout moment. ## Puoi aspettarti questo. Con FFS Cargo avete il polso dell'economia svizzera. FFS Cargo trasporta ogni giorno 185.000 tonnellate, riduce il carico sulle strade di 15.000 viaggi di camion al giorno e l'impatto sull'ambiente di 460.000 tonnellate di CO2 ogni anno. Vi aspetta un ambiente di lavoro innovativo in cui voi e i vostri collaboratori potrete far progredire FFS Cargo. Riceverai anche una formazione varia e retribuita nello scalo di smistamento. Avete a disposizione anche diverse opportunità di perfezionamento, come ad esempio la formazione per diventare macchinista di manovra. Per noi sono importanti condizioni di lavoro attraenti, anche in caso di orari di lavoro irregolari. Per il lavoro notturno e nel fine settimana paghiamo un salario supplementare, per il lavoro domenicale ad esempio 16 franchi l'ora. Per i turni notturni riceverai anche un'indennità compresa tra il 10 e il 30%. Ciò significa che hai più tempo libero rispetto ai dipendenti senza turni notturni e nei fine settimana. Possibili date di inizio nel 2026:

- 1 ottobre 2026
Puoi spostarlo. - In qualità di specialista delle manovre, contribuirai a garantire che i nostri clienti siano serviti in modo affidabile e puntuale preparando i treni merci per il loro viaggio. - Prendi in consegna i vagoni, esegui i controlli di sicurezza e prepari il treno per il viaggio successivo attraverso complessi movimenti di manovra. - Registrate i dati necessari per il percorso del treno utilizzando moderni dispositivi informatici personali (ad es. tablet). - Consegnando e riconsegnando le auto presso la sede del cliente in modo tempestivo, hai un contatto diretto con il cliente su base giornaliera. Ricevi il loro feedback e, se necessario, lo inoltri all'ufficio responsabile. Puoi scoprire di più sul profilo lavorativo qui. Questo è quello che porti con te.

- Sei attento, concentrato e fisicamente resistente per completare con successo questo lavoro impegnativo in turni di 24 ore. Ti piace anche lavorare all'aperto con qualsiasi tempo. - Idealmente, hai completato la formazione di base o hai già esperienza professionale nel settore dell'artigianato, della logistica o in un settore comparabile. - Poiché tutte le istruzioni e la documentazione sono elettroniche, potrai orientarti rapidamente utilizzando gli strumenti digitali. - In tedesco (livello C1) finché non parli e scrivi fluentemente. - Hai un perfetto senso dei colori (nessun punto debole del rosso-verde) e non hai iscrizioni nel registro penale o delle esecuzioni.

## You can look forward to this. At SBB Cargo you have your finger on the pulse of the Swiss economy. SBB Cargo transports 185,000 tons every day, reducing the burden on the roads by 15,000 truck trips per day and reducing the burden on the environment by 460,000 tons of CO2 every year. An innovative working environment awaits you in which you and your teammates will move SBB Cargo forward. You will also receive varied and paid training in the marshalling yard. There are also various further training opportunities available to you, such as training to become a shunting engine driver. Attractive working conditions are important to us, even with irregular working hours. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work - for example, 16 francs per hour for Sunday work. For night shifts you will also receive a time allowance of between 10 and 30%. This means that you have more free time than employees without night and weekend shifts. Possible start dates in 2026:
- August 1, 2026
- October 1, 2026
You can move that. - As a shunting specialist, you will help ensure that our customers are served reliably and on time by preparing freight trains for their journey. - You take over the cars, carry out safety checks and prepare the train for the next journey through complex shunting movements. - You record the necessary data for train routing using personal, modern IT devices (e.g. tablet). - By delivering and dropping off the cars at the customer's site in a timely manner, you have direct customer contact on a daily basis. You receive their feedback and, if necessary, forward it to the responsible office. You can find out more about the job profile here. This is what you bring with you.

- You are attentive, concentrated and physically resilient in order to successfully complete this demanding work in 24-hour shifts. You also enjoy working outside in any weather. - Ideally, you have completed basic training or already have professional experience in crafts, logistics or a comparable area. - Since all instructions and documentation are electronic, you will quickly find your way around using digital tools. - In German (level C1) until you are fluent in speech and writing. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red-green weakness) and have no entries in the criminal or debt enforcement register.

## Vous pouvez vous attendre à cela. Chez CFF Cargo, vous prenez le pouls de l'économie suisse. CFF Cargo transporte 185 000 tonnes par jour, réduisant ainsi la pollution routière de 15 000 déplacements de camion par jour et l'impact sur l'environnement de 460 000 tonnes de CO2 par an. Un environnement de travail innovant vous attend dans lequel vous et vos collaborateurs ferez avancer CFF Cargo. Vous bénéficierez également d'une formation variée et rémunérée en gare de triage. Diverses possibilités de formation continue s'offrent également à vous, comme par exemple la formation de conducteur de locomotive de manœuvre. Des conditions de travail attrayantes sont importantes pour nous, même en cas d'horaires de travail irréguliers. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end - par exemple 16 francs de l'heure pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficierez également d'une indemnité de temps comprise entre 10 et 30 %. Cela signifie que vous disposez de plus de temps libre que les employés qui ne travaillent pas de nuit ni de week-end. Dates de début possibles en 2026 :
- 1er août 2026
- 1er octobre 2026
Vous pouvez déplacer cela. - En tant que spécialiste des manœuvres, vous contribuerez à ce que nos clients soient servis de manière fiable et à temps en préparant les trains de marchandises pour leur voyage. - Vous prenez en charge les wagons, effectuez les contrôles de sécurité et préparez le train pour le prochain voyage à travers des mouvements de manœuvres complexes. - Vous enregistrez les données nécessaires à l'itinéraire des trains à l'aide d'appareils informatiques personnels et modernes (par exemple une tablette). - En livrant et en déposant les voitures sur le site du client dans les meilleurs délais, vous avez un contact direct avec le client au quotidien. Vous recevez leurs commentaires et, si nécessaire, vous les transmettez au bureau responsable. Vous pouvez en savoir plus sur le profil de poste ici. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous.

- Vous êtes attentif, concentré et résilient physiquement afin de mener à bien ce travail exigeant en 24 heures. Vous aimez également travailler dehors par tous les temps. - Idéalement, vous avez suivi une formation de base ou possédez déjà une expérience professionnelle dans l'artisanat, la logistique ou un domaine comparable. - Toutes les instructions et documentations étant électroniques, vous vous y retrouverez rapidement grâce aux outils numériques. - En allemand (niveau C1) jusqu'à ce que vous parliez et écriviez couramment. - Vous avez un sens parfait de la couleur (pas de faiblesse rouge-vert) et n'êtes pas inscrit au casier judiciaire ou aux poursuites.

## Votre salaire et vos avantages sociaux.
Nous disposons d’un système salarial juste et progressif et nous nous engageons activement en faveur de l’égalité salariale. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence E, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux.

Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Ton poste dans le monde de la mobilité
En tant que partenaire de formation des CFF, du BLS, des RhB, de l'Union des transports publics (UTP) et de plus de 80 autres entreprises actives dans le domaine de la mobilité ou proches de celles-ci, login formation professionnelle SA organise des apprentissages professionnels, des stages et des formations complémentaires en phase avec le marché pour environ 2100 personnes en formation dans plus de 35 professions différentes.
Sur mandat de l'UTP, login organise les cours interentreprises (CIE) de l'apprentissage des agent·e·s de transport ferroviaire CFC. Pour le début de l'apprentissage 1er août 2026 , nous recherchons un·e
Responsable des CIE pour les agent·e·s de transport ferroviaire CFC
(15 jours de cours pendant les deux premières années d'apprentissage)

## Ce que tu peux faire bouger :
- Qualification des apprenti·e·s agent·e·s de transport ferroviaire CFC dans le cadre des CIE ainsi que leur préparation en vue de leur engagement sur la place d'apprentissage
- Planification individuelle de la préparation et du suivi des CIE (p. ex. documentation des performances des apprenti·e·s dans le cadre des contrôles de compétences)
- Développement des compétences méthodologiques et sociales ainsi que l'accompagnement des apprenti·e·s en fonction de la situation

- Apprentissage achevé de conducteur·trice de véhicules moteurs cat. A40 et minimum 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle dans le domaine des TP
- Achèvement du certificat FSEA ou d'une formation didactique équivalente, ou disposition à suivre une telle formation.
- Esprit d'initiative et personnalité communicative , disposant déjà d'une expérience en tant que formateur·trice ou dans une autre activité liée à la formation

On mandate from UTP, login organizes inter-company courses (CIE) for the apprenticeship of CFC rail transport agents. For the start of the apprenticeship on August 1, 2026, we are looking for a CIE Manager for CFC rail transport agents (15 days of courses during the first two years of apprenticeship) ## What you can make happen: - Qualification of CFC rail transport agent apprentices within the framework of the CIEs as well as their preparation for their engagement on the apprenticeship - Individual planning of the preparation and monitoring of the apprenticeships CIE (e.g. documentation of apprentices' performance in the context of skills checks) - Development of methodological and social skills as well as support for apprentices depending on the situation - Active use of own professional experience in the field of public transport (TP) ##
• What you bring: - Completed apprenticeship as a driver of motor vehicles cat. A40 and minimum 5 years of professional experience in the field of TP - Completion of the FSEA certificate or equivalent didactic training, or willingness to follow such training. - Spirit of initiative and communicative personality, already having experience as a trainer or in another activity linked to training - Pleasure in working with young people - Methodological and didactic skills, as well as a confident and professional attitude ## What awaits you: A varied and demanding activity, with a certain margin of maneuver, in a dynamic environment. Have we piqued your interest? For any further information, do not hesitate to contact Simon Eng, training manager. We look forward to receiving your application via our application tool.

Beweg die Schweiz mit uns.
Rangierspezialist:in Infrastruktur
Winterthur, 01.03.2026 oder nach Vereinbarung, 60-100%
Jetzt bewerben

## Darauf kannst du dich freuen.
Bei der SBB hast du die Chance, dein Können einzubringen und dir gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten anzueignen, die dich beruflich bereichern und weiterbringen.
Als Bauzugbegleiter:in kannst du einen Grundstein legen für eine weitere Karriere als Lokführer:in Bauzüge.
Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Bei Nachteinsätzen erhältst du Zeitzuschläge von 10 bis 30%, was dir mehr Freizeit ermöglicht.
Benefits wie kostenloses GA, vergünstigtes Reisen im Ausland - auch für die Familie - findest du auf unserer Website unter Benefits und mehr Infos zum Beruf findest du hier
Das kannst du bewegen.
- In dieser abwechslungsreichen Position trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Bauzüge pünktlich abfahrbereit sind und sicherst damit die Eisenbahnbaulogistik.
- Als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du die betriebliche und technische Zuguntersuchung und unterstützt den/die Lokführer:in bei sicheren Zugfahrten von A nach B.
- Du begleitest dabei sowohl Rangier- als auch Zugfahrten.
- Nebst deiner Tätigkeit als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du auf der Baustelle eine Sicherheitsfunktion oder unterstützt deine Kollegen:innen bei Arbeiten im Gleisbereich.
Das bringst du mit.
- Für diese anspruchsvolle Arbeit im 24-Stunden-Schichtbetrieb bist du körperlich und psychisch belastbar und arbeitest gerne bei jedem Wetter draussen.
- Du hast eine Grundbildung abgeschlossen und verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene Berufslehre. Zudem bringst du bereits Berufserfahrungen im handwerklichen, logistischen oder vergleichbaren Bereich mit.
- Die Weiterbildungen zum Bauzugbegleiter:in (Kat. Ai), Sicherheitswärter:in und oder Sicherheitschef:in hast du erfolgreich abgeschlossen.
- Bei deiner täglichen Arbeit bedienst du unter anderem ein Tablet. Der Umgang mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln bereitet dir keine Mühe.
- In Deutsch bist du fliessend in Wort und Schrift.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche).

## Dein Lohn und deine Benefits.
Wir haben ein faires und fortschrittliches Lohnsystem und setzen uns aktiv für Lohngleichheit ein. Deshalb sind weiterführende und detaillierte Informationen zum Lohnsystem bei der SBB transparent einsehbar. Diese Stelle befindet sich im Anforderungsniveau D, Regionalzulage Stufe 1. Mehr zu Lohn und Benefits .

## Damit gelingt der Einstieg.
Dass du mit uns die Schweiz bewegen willst, ist für uns die grösste Motivation. Darum verzichten wir bei dieser Stelle auf ein Motivationsschreiben. Falls du uns deine Motivation dennoch mitteilen möchtest, hast du in unserem Bewerbungstool nach wie vor die Möglichkeit dazu.
Grosses machen ist einfacher per du. Das beginnt bereits bei deiner Bewerbung.

Shunting specialist: in infrastructure Winterthur, March 1st, 2026 or by appointment, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to this. At SBB you have the chance to use your skills and at the same time acquire new skills that will enrich and advance your career. As a construction train attendant, you can lay the foundation for a further career as a construction train driver. You see irregular working hours and shift work as an advantage in order to enjoy your free time while others are working. We pay additional wages for night and weekend work, for example with an additional hourly wage of 16 francs for Sunday work. For night shifts, you receive a time allowance of 10 to 30%, which gives you more free time. You can find benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - on our website under Benefits and you can find more information about the job here. You can make a difference. - In this varied position, you will help ensure that our construction trains are ready to leave on time and thus ensure railway construction logistics. - As a construction train attendant, you take on operational and technical train inspections and support the locomotive driver in safe train journeys from A to B. - You accompany both shunting and train journeys. - In addition to your work as a construction train attendant, you take on a safety role on the construction site or support your colleagues when working in the track area. This is what you bring with you. - You are physically and mentally resilient for this demanding work in 24-hour shifts and enjoy working outside in any weather. - You have completed basic training and ideally have completed a vocational apprenticeship. You also have professional experience in crafts, logistics or comparable areas. - You have successfully completed the further training to become a construction train attendant (Cat. Ai), security guard and or head of security. - In your daily work you use, among other things, a tablet. You don't have to worry about using modern work equipment. - You are fluent in spoken and written German. - You have a perfect sense of color (no red/green weakness). ## Your salary and your benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information about the wage system at SBB can be viewed transparently. This position is at requirement level D, regional allowance level 1. More about wages and benefits. ## This gets you started. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is our greatest motivation. That's why we don't include a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Doing great things is easier if you do it yourself. Bei der SBB hast du die Chance, dein Können einzubringen und dir gleichzeitig neue Fähigkeiten anzueignen, die dich beruflich bereichern und weiterbringen.

Du siehst unregelmässige Arbeitszeiten und Schichtarbeit als Vorteil, um deine Freizeit zu geniessen, während andere arbeiten. Nacht- und Wochenendarbeiten werden bei uns zusätzlich vergütet, z.B. mit einem Stundenlohnzusatz von 16 Franken für Sonntagsarbeit. Das kannst du bewegen.

- Als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du die betriebliche und technische Zuguntersuchung und unterstützt den/die Lokführer:in bei sicheren Zugfahrten von A nach B.

- Nebst deiner Tätigkeit als Bauzugbegleiter:in übernimmst du auf der Baustelle eine Sicherheitsfunktion oder unterstützt deine Kollegen:innen bei Arbeiten im Gleisbereich.

- Bei deiner täglichen Arbeit bedienst du unter anderem ein Tablet. Der Umgang mit modernen Arbeitsmitteln bereitet dir keine Mühe.
- In Deutsch bist du fliessend in Wort und Schrift.
- Du verfügst über einen einwandfreien Farbsinn (keine Rot- / Grünschwäche).

En tant qu'accompagnateur de train de construction, vous pouvez jeter les bases d'une future carrière de conducteur de train de construction. Vous considérez les horaires de travail irréguliers et le travail posté comme un avantage pour profiter de votre temps libre pendant que d'autres travaillent. Nous payons un supplément de salaire pour le travail de nuit et de week-end, par exemple avec un salaire horaire supplémentaire de 16 francs pour le travail du dimanche. Pour les quarts de nuit, vous bénéficiez d'une indemnité de temps de 10 à 30 %, ce qui vous laisse plus de temps libre. Vous pouvez trouver des avantages tels qu'une AG gratuite, des voyages à l'étranger à prix réduit - également pour la famille - sur notre site Web sous Avantages et vous pouvez trouver plus d'informations sur le poste ici. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. - Vous êtes résilient physiquement et mentalement pour ce travail exigeant en quarts de 24 heures et aimez travailler dehors par tous les temps. - Vous avez suivi une formation de base et idéalement effectué un apprentissage professionnel. Des informations complémentaires et détaillées sur le système salarial des CFF peuvent ainsi être consultées en toute transparence. Ce poste est au niveau d'exigence D, niveau d'allocation régionale 1. En savoir plus sur les salaires et les avantages sociaux. ## Cela vous permet de démarrer. Le fait que vous souhaitiez déménager en Suisse avec nous est notre plus grande motivation. C'est pourquoi nous n'incluons pas de lettre de motivation à ce stade. Si vous souhaitez tout de même nous faire part de votre motivation, vous avez toujours la possibilité de le faire dans notre outil de candidature.
